Product Owner – Trust Services (eIDAS2, EUDI Wallet & Trust Platform) (f/m/d)
Delivery Manager Genflex
jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🐙 Kraken Generation Flex


The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves to be at the heart of that change.

Our aim is to be the leading global provider of solutions that enable customers to release £30bn of value per annum from distributed energy resources (DERs). We are building a Software as a Service (SaaS) subscription business with a global addressable market of £2.4 billion per annum, by digitally connecting hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets.

We have already attained a market leading position and Kraken is a recognised thought leader and innovator in the industry.

🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary

As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU.

This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform.

You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated.

Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding:

Customer: What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them?

Product: How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required?

Engineering: How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work?

Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution.

🚀 What you'll own

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding and delivery of Generation Flex assets BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar), from initial onboarding through analysis, site design, installation, configuration, commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

  • Build a strong understanding of the Generation Flex product and SaaS platform, including how assets are represented, configured, monitored and controlled within KrakenFlex.

  • Understand how the physical site and its electrical/control systems connect into the KrakenFlex software architecture, and bring those two worlds together throughout onboarding.

  • Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset.

  • Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements, making sure each group understands what is needed from the others.

  • Understand the end-to-end data and control path from the physical asset through site controls, meters, PPCs, gateways and communications infrastructure into Kraken Flex, and from Kraken Flex back to the asset where control is required.

  • Ensure that the customer's intended use of the GenFlex product is reflected in the technical onboarding solution, including the required telemetry, controls, configuration, integrations and product modules.

  • Be able to explain to customers how their site will interact with KrakenFlex, both from a physical integration perspective and from a software/product perspective.

  • Work with Product teams to identify where customer or asset requirements do not fit current product capabilities, and ensure gaps, constraints or product dependencies are surfaced early.

  • Feed recurring onboarding challenges, customer requirements and technical integration pain points back into Product and Engineering teams to help improve and scale the GenFlex proposition.

  • Be the primary delivery point of contact for customers during site onboarding, setting clear expectations around what we need from them, what Kraken is delivering and what needs to happen next.

  • Work closely with our Electrical Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams to ensure the technical information required to integrate a site is complete, accurate and available at the right stage of delivery.

  • Review and interpret customer technical documentation including:

    • Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)

    • Network and communications diagrams

    • Site and asset specifications

    • PPC and controller documentation

    • Modbus register maps

    • IP addressing and network information

    • Functional Design Specifications

    • Metering and telemetry information

    • Hardware and connectivity requirements

  • Be confident discussing technical site architecture with customers and engineers, understanding how equipment such as generators, batteries, meters, PPCs, controllers, gateways and site networks fit together.

  • Identify missing, inconsistent or technically unclear customer information early and drive it to resolution before it becomes a delivery blocker.

  • Coordinate the preparation and review of Kraken integration documentation, including gateway architecture, communications diagrams, Kraken SLDs, integration designs and site configuration information.

  • Coordinate the Kraken Gateway delivery and installation process, ensuring prerequisites such as power, networking, connectivity and installation arrangements are understood and ready.

  • Manage readiness for key commissioning and testing activities, including:

    • Gateway installation and connectivity

    • Operational acceptance testing

    • Kraken market and service testing

  • Proactively manage delivery risks and communicate issues and mitigation plans clearly to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Surface blockers early and drive the right people together to resolve them rather than allowing issues to sit between teams.

  • Maintain clear visibility of the status and health of each site, including technical readiness, product readiness, customer actions, Kraken actions and upcoming milestones.

  • Continuously improve the Generation Flex onboarding process, identifying recurring technical, product or customer blockers and working with Engineering, Product and Operations teams to remove them.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

  • A strong technical background and the confidence to work closely with electrical, control systems, and networking.

  • The ability to read and understand an Electrical Single Line Diagram (SLD) and use it to understand the electrical architecture of a site.

  • A practical understanding of industrial networking and communications, including concepts such as IP addressing, LANs, routers, switches, VPNs and site connectivity.

  • Enough electrical engineering knowledge to understand concepts such as metering, breakers, transformers, generators, inverters, batteries and asset control systems.

  • Experience delivering technical projects involving the integration, commissioning or onboarding of physical assets, ideally within energy, renewables, utilities, industrial automation, controls or a similar environment.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to take a complicated technical problem and clearly explain the issue, impact, owner and next action.

  • Experience coordinating multiple teams and dependencies across customers, Electrical Engineering, hardware, installation partners and other third parties.

  • A highly organised approach to delivery, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple sites at different stages of onboarding simultaneously.

  • The ability to proactively identify risk, remove blockers and maintain momentum in an environment where customer readiness and site timelines can change quickly.

  • A customer-centric mindset and a drive to provide an outstanding onboarding experience without compromising technical quality.

  • A pragmatic, collaborative approach and the confidence to operate in a fast-moving environment where processes and products are still evolving.

  • A strong interest in understanding how a SaaS product works end-to-end, rather than treating the software platform as a black box.

  • A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment, comfortable navigating the complexity and comfortable being the regional face of site onboarding function.

  • Language: professional fluency in English. A second European language would be preferable.

⭐️ Bonus points

  • Experience in APIs, data flows, system integrations or cloud software architecture would be beneficial.

  • Experience in flexible generation, battery storage, renewable energy, demand response or distributed energy resources.

  • A working understanding of industrial communication protocols and controlled environments would be helpful (e.g. modbus, OPC UA )

  • Experience commissioning or integrating generators, BESS, solar, EV infrastructure or other industrial energy assets.

  • Previous experience working with grid-connected assets, control systems or energy market services.

  • Experience with SaaS implementation, technical product onboarding or systems integration.

  • Familiarity with commissioning processes and the distinction between cold commissioning, energisation and hot commissioning.

  • Experience with industrial gateways, edge devices or IoT connectivity.

jobs.title: Développeur fullstack confirmé H/F (C#, .Net, Angular)
jobs.description:
À propos de N2JSoft

N2JSoft est une Fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Fondée en 2015, elle compte aujourd’hui 20 000 clients et 1M utilisateurs dans 98 pays, faisant de N2F l’un des leaders du marché français.

N2F simplifie la gestion des frais professionnels : photo des justificatifs, reconnaissance automatique, validation, export comptable, archivage à valeur probante, etc.

L’objectif : faire gagner du temps aux entreprises tout en sécurisant leurs processus internes.

Après une croissance progressive, l’équipe est passée de 20 personnes en 2021 à 220 aujourd’hui, portée par le succès produit et l’expansion internationale.

Nous partageons un objectif commun : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des notes de frais et des factures fournisseurs.

En 2021, N2JSoft a élargi son expertise avec Keeple, un logiciel RH dédié aux congés, absences et temps de travail (hors périmètre de ce poste).

Nous prévoyons de recruter 100 nouveaux collaborateurs d’ici 2027. Notre objectif est également d’accélérer la croissance de nos produits, ce qui passe par le renforcement de notre équipe de développement.

Quelques chiffres

  • 220 collaborateurs, dont 45 dans l'équipe tech

  • Notre site est basé à Montagnat (01) avec un format de télétravail hybride ou full remote.

L’équipe tech

Notre équipe est composée de développeurs/euses full stack expérimenté(e)s, réparti(e)s en squads : Notes de frais, Cartes de paiement pro, Invoices, Core…

Chaque squad réunit : développeurs/euses, tech lead, team lead, product manager et testeur/euses QA.

Stack et pratiques

Front : Angular 16/21

Back : .NET 10 – C#

Infra : AWS

BDD : MSSQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB

Architecture : monolithe modulaire

Bonnes pratiques : tests unitaires, revues de code, pair programming, couverture Qodana, Microsoft Release Flow.

Méthodo : Agile Scrum, sprints de 2 semaines (daily, weekly, rétro, planning).


Le profil recherché

Rattaché(e) à un(e) Team Lead dans l'une des squads produit, tu disposes :

  • D'une formation en informatique Bac+3 minimum

  • De 3 ans d’expérience en .NET / C# (web ou backend)

  • De 2 ans d'expérience sur Angular et de bonnes connaissances front-end (HTML/CSS, TypeScript)

  • D'une bonne maîtrise de SQL

  • D'une expérience avec les technologies Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) et Docker

Et tu fais preuve :

  • D'esprit d’équipe pour travailler dans un climat de confiance, d'entraide et de responsabilité partagée

  • De curiosité et d'ouverture pour comprendre le besoin de nos utilisateurs et l'environnement technique

  • De pragmatisme et rigueur pour produire un code fiable avec un impact maîtrisé.

Les points d’attention :

  • Il est crucial de bien comprendre le périmètre fonctionnel du produit pour réussir dans ce poste.

  • Nous recherchons quelqu’un qui souhaite s’investir dans la durée et contribuer à la construction d’un projet pérenne, plutôt qu’à une mission ponctuelle.

Les plus :

  • Une croissance forte et continue (50% par an depuis 3 ans) dans une entreprise rentable

  • Une structure claire et spécialisée avec une équipe tech solide et des squads bien identifiées

  • Une stack moderne régulièrement mise à jour, avec des migrations planifiées et suivies

  • Pas de micro management et une culture de travail basée sur la confiance et l’écoute

  • La possibilité de faire du full-remote avec une semaine de présence par trimestre

Processus de recrutement

  1. Préqualification avec nos recruteurs

  2. Test technique à réaliser en autonomie (7 jours de deadline)

  3. Entretien technique / code review avec notre équipe tech (1h)

  4. Entretien avec le CTO (40 min)

A la fin du processus de recrutement, une rencontre plus informelle de 20 minutes peut être organisée afin de rencontrer tes futurs collègues.

Télétravail :

Environ 100 de nos collaborateurs travaillent en full remote, depuis différentes régions. Pour celles et ceux qui résident à proximité de nos locaux, une présence quotidienne est privilégiée (avec un jour de télétravail par semaine). Les personnes situées à environ une heure de route viennent généralement deux jours par semaine sur site.

Pour les collaborateurs en full remote, nous organisons une semaine de présence par trimestre, prise en charge par l’entreprise, afin de renforcer les liens avec l’équipe et de partager les temps forts de la vie interne.

Ces semaines s’inscrivent dans notre rythme d’événements trimestriels (ateliers, moments conviviaux, séminaires, etc.), qui participent à la cohésion et à la culture d’équipe.

En résumé, nous adaptons le rythme de télétravail à la situation géographique de chacun, dans un esprit de flexibilité, de confiance et de collaboration.

Rémunération et avantages

  • 40–50k€ brut annuel en fonction de l’expérience/niveau technique

  • CDI cadre – 37h/semaine

  • Prime de vacances

  • Chèques cadeaux, culture, rentrée scolaire

  • Cours de musique sur site

  • Événements d’équipe toute l’année

N2JSOFT s'engage en faveur de la diversité, l'égalité hommes-femmes et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés.

jobs.title: Product Manager  H/F
Principal Program Manager (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
About lemon.markets 🍋

We enable anyone to be an investor. Our mission is to grow investing opportunities for all European customers and businesses. By empowering FinTechs, banks, and wealth managers to offer investment products, we help create financial well-being for their customers.

lemon.markets is a Brokerage-as-a-Service platform: simple digital access to capital markets through a single API. Our API-first infrastructure abstracts brokerage complexity with a well-documented API, a self-service customer operations portal, and a clear regulatory framework, so partners can launch customer-centric, compliant products in weeks, not months.

As part of the dwpbank Group, we share a clear goal: making investing in capital markets more accessible. By combining dwpbank’s long-standing expertise and stability with lemon.markets’ technology-first mindset and speed, we are building a modern, modular securities services ecosystem. Together, we offer faster time-to-market, modular services, and a modern customer experience that helps financial service providers stay competitive and respond more flexibly in a changing market.

Your Mission
As we deepen our collaboration with our parent company, dwpbank, we are looking for a highly strategic and execution-focused person to lead one of our most important cross-company initiatives.

In this role, you will act as the central coordination point for a joint offering with dwpbank. You will bring clarity to complexity, align stakeholders across both organizations, and drive the overall program across commercial, product, and governance workstreams. Your job is to ensure that the right topics move forward, dependencies are surfaced early, and teams stay focused on what matters most.

In this role you will:

  • Own the overall coordination of a critical cross-company strategic program between lemon.markets and dwpbank.

  • Help shape how lemon.markets’ and dwpbank’s offerings come together into a compelling joint proposition for shared customers.

  • Collaborate closely with product, engineering, operations, legal, and commercial stakeholders to ensure seamless execution across the full value chain.

  • Act as the connective layer across teams and senior stakeholders, ensuring that priorities, decisions, risks, and dependencies are transparent and actively managed.

  • Work closely with senior leaders at lemon.markets and dwpbank to keep the program on track and escalate where needed.

  • Identify strategic risks and opportunities early, connect the dots across domains, and proactively steer the program accordingly.

  • Translate complex discussions and developments into clear recommendations, concrete next steps, and actionable decisions.

  • Keep momentum high across all involved stakeholders by driving follow-through, enabling effective communication across teams, building bridges between organizations and functions, and ensuring lemoneers and leadership have the right information and context at the right time.

  • Partner with internal commercial teams and dwpbank counterparts to support business development efforts for the joint offering.

You’ll be successful in this role if you:

  • Bring strong experience in program management, strategic project leadership, or change delivery in a complex financial-services environment.

  • Have experience in securities services, custody, brokerage, wealth management, asset management, or adjacent financial infrastructure environments.

  • Understand how to navigate regulated environments and cross-functional dependencies across multiple senior stakeholders.

  • Are able to absorb complex context quickly, structure ambiguity, and turn it into practical action.

  • Are not just a status-tracker: you bring judgment, anticipate what matters, and actively steer topics before they become problems.

  • Combine strategic thinking with a hands-on mindset, strong execution discipline, and a clear drive to make progress.

  • Are a patient, thoughtful communicator who can build trust, create alignment, and move topics forward across organizational boundaries and seniority levels.

  • Know how to facilitate communication across diverse stakeholder groups, ensure the right context is shared with the right people, and help teams stay aligned even in complex or sensitive situations.

  • Have strong commercial instincts and understand how product, execution, and business development interact in strategic initiatives.

  • Are fluent in German and English.

How we take care of you:

  • 🚀 Compensation package: We offer you a competitive salary, based on your experience and the value-add you bring to lemon.markets.

  • 🕑 Flexible working hours: We trust people to choose when they work best and avoid a rigid 9 to 5 mindset. You decide on the rhythm that helps you do your best work, with only shared core hours from 12:00 to 16:00 to support collaboration.

  • 🏢 Hybrid work setup: You can work from anywhere in Germany within a hybrid model. At the same time, in-person collaboration is a key part of our culture. That being said, individual contributer lemoneers work 4 days or more per month on-site in our Berlin office, spending quality time together with the team at events, onsites/offsites or over team dinners.

  • 📈 Grow with us: We take your personal development seriously! You’ll get regular mentorship and stretch opportunities, a clear career development framework with frequent feedback conversations as well as an annual learning budget.

  • 🌱 People & culture: You’ll feel our culture in the small things, like polaroids from our lemoneers’ first day, Friday food market strolls at Maybachufer, and our monthly new-joiner breakfast. But also in the bigger things: celebrating the onboarding of new partners, growing our teams, and owning a strong discussion culture.

  • 💛 Perks & benefits: We choose benefits that add actual value. We sponsor a Deutschlandticket for employees on unlimited contracts, plus 50% off on Beatvest - our partner for financial education and investing.

  • 🏝 Workation: Get out of here! At lemon.markets you can work remotely from anywhere in the EU for up to 10 consecutive days at a time, and up to 60 days per year in total.

 

As an equal opportunity employer, lemon.markets is committed to building an inclusive workplace. The company welcomes people from all different backgrounds, including age, citizenship, ethnic and racial origins, gender identities, individuals with disabilities, marital status, religions and ideologies, and sexual orientations to apply.

If you feel this role could be a great match for you even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you, please apply.

Deine Aufgaben

Du gestaltest E-Commerce-Erlebnisse, die Kunden begeistern und die Conversion messbar verbessern? Du denkst in durchgängigen User Journeys, hast einen scharfen Blick für UX/UI-Details und suchst eine Rolle mit voller Ownership für den Shop?

Dann suchst du genau uns – und wir dich! Als unser/e E-Commerce Product Owner:in bist du die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Produkt/Dev, Operations und Marketing. Du baust Features, die Kunden weiterbringen und die Conversion messbar heben – und machst unseren Shop damit zum Maßstab in seiner Klasse.
Deine Mission 

  • Full Ownership & UX/UI-Exzellenz: Du bist die treibende Kraft hinter unserem Webshop. Du ownsed die Produkt-Roadmap, steuerst die Features nach Business-Impact und sorgst für ein nahtloses, kundenfreundliches UI/UX-Erlebnis auf allen Devices.

  • Conversion- & Journey-Optimierung: Du drehst an den richtigen Stellschrauben über den gesamten Funnel hinweg, von der Suche über die PDP (Product Detail Page) bis zum Checkout.

  • Data-Driven Growth: GA4, BI und A/B-Tests sind deine Spielwiese. Du übernimmst die KPI-Verantwortung (CVR, AOV, Warenkorbabbrüche, RPV) und leitest daraus konkrete Hypothesen und Experimente ab.

  • Smart Features & Ökosysteme: Du entwickelst kundenfreundliche Kompatibilitäts-Filter (Matter, Apple Home, Alexa etc.) sowie intelligente Starter-Set- und Bundle-Mechaniken, die Erklärungsbedarf reduzieren und den Warenkorbwert steigern.

  • Next-Level AI-Shopping: Du verantwortest innovative KI-Features - von Guided Selling über semantische Suchen bis hin zum Conversational Smart-Home-Assistant.

  • Agile Schnittstelle: Du übersetzt Kundenbedürfnisse und Business-Ziele in klare Requirements für unser Tech-, Design- und Marketing-Team und stellst die höchste Qualität bei jedem Release sicher.

  • E-Commerce DNA: Mehrjährige Erfahrung im transaktionalen E-Commerce mit nachweisbaren Erfolgen bei der CVR- und Funnel-Optimierung (Du lieferst Kennzahlen, nicht nur Features!).

  • Deep Tech- & Analytics-Verständnis: Sicheres Händchen für Web-Analytics (GA4, Tracking-Konzepte, Dashboards), Grundkenntnisse in SQL sowie fundiertes Verständnis von modernen E-Commerce-Architekturen (Shopware, Magento, commercetools oder Headless/APIs).

  • UX/UI & Qualitätssinn: Du hast ein hervorragendes Auge für intuitive Benutzerführung und den Anspruch, nur absolut makellose, kundenfreundliche Web-Anwendungen live zu bringen.

  • AI-First Mindset: Du nutzt KI-Tools ganz selbstverständlich in deinem täglichen Workflow, um Analysen, Specs oder Experimente extrem schnell auf das nächste Level zu heben.

  • Office-First & Team-Vibes: Du liebst den persönlichen Austausch, schätzt schnelle Kommunikationswege und hast richtig Lust, jeden Tag gemeinsam mit deinem Team in unserem wunderschönen Office im Herzen von Berlin-Mitte zu arbeiten.

    • Erfahrung im Umfeld erklärungsbedürftiger Produkte (Consumer Electronics, Technik oder Smart Home).

    • Verständnis für Smart-Home-Standards und Plattform-Ökosysteme.

jobs.title: Product Manager – Platform Experience & Cloud Administration (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
What is Jedox?

Jedox is a leading provider of Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) solutions, helping organizations plan, analyze, and drive business performance with confidence. More than 2,000 companies worldwide, from ambitious mid-sized businesses to global enterprises, rely on Jedox to streamline planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes.
Recognized as a leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™, Jedox combines powerful planning capabilities with a modern cloud platform that enables businesses to adapt quickly and make informed decisions. At Jedox, we believe in innovation, impactful results, people centricity, and the power of #OneTeam to help our customers succeed.


Your Responsibilities

As Product Manager – Platform Experience & Cloud Administration, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of key platform experiences including navigation, onboarding, user access, and cloud administration. Working closely with Engineering, Design, and Architecture, you will drive improvements that enhance usability, customer trust, and platform scalability, helping shape how thousands of users experience Jedox every day.

What You'll Do

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap: Define and drive the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for Platform Navigation, BaseUI, and Cloud Console capabilities.
  • Lead discovery and product validation: Conduct user research, gather stakeholder input, analyze customer needs, and validate opportunities to ensure impactful product investments.
  • Shape the platform experience: Improve navigation, onboarding, login experiences, session management, and integrations with platform services such as analytics and feature flagging solutions.
  • Drive Cloud Console evolution: Enhance the self-service administration experience, enabling IT teams to efficiently manage environments, users, permissions, and access controls.
  • Manage end-to-end product delivery: Guide initiatives from concept through delivery, launch, and communication while ensuring high-quality execution and measurable outcomes.
  • Prioritize and make trade-offs: Balance customer needs, technical complexity, business priorities, and long-term platform goals to make informed product decisions.
  • Partner with Engineering and Architecture: Collaborate closely with technical leaders to align short-term delivery with sustainable platform architecture and scalability.
  • Enable cross-functional alignment: Work with Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and Leadership teams to build shared understanding and drive successful execution.
  • Monitor product success: Define key outcomes, measure adoption and user experience improvements, and continuously optimize platform capabilities.
  • Champion customer-centric innovation: Ensure platform experiences support both end users and IT administrators while strengthening customer trust and satisfaction.
What Success Looks Like in Your First Year

jobs.description:
Pfaffenhofen a. d. Ilm • Vollzeit • ab sofort

Wir sind EXP Software GmbH: Wir sind ein Team aus rund 25 Softwareentwickler*innen mit Herz, Humor und Leidenschaft für Technologie. Wir bauen explore, eine Agentic-Twin-Plattform, die Unternehmen dabei hilft, komplexe Prozesse durch autonome KI-Agenten abzubilden und zu automatisieren.Unser Produkt wächst und damit auch die Anforderungen an jemanden, der den Überblick behält: zwischen dem, was Kunden brauchen, was die Geschäftsführung vorhat, und dem, was das Entwicklungsteam realistisch umsetzen kann. Genau diese Brücke baust du. Wir suchen keinen Prozess-Verwalter, der Tickets schiebt. Wir suchen jemanden, der explore wirklich versteht, sich für das Produkt begeistert und mit Klarheit und Konsequenz dafür sorgt, dass die richtigen Dinge in der richtigen Reihenfolge gebaut werden.

Aufgaben

Produktvision & Roadmap

  • Du erstellst und verantwortest das Product Backlog für explore: Pflege, Priorisierung und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung in enger Abstimmung mit Geschäftsführung, Kunden und Entwicklungsteam.
  • Du übersetzt Geschäftsziele und Kundenanforderungen in klare, umsetzbare User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien, und das präzise genug für das Team und verständlich genug für alle anderen.
  • Du setzt klare Prioritäten und begründest sie: Was bauen wir als nächstes – und warum?
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung eine mittelfristige Produkt-Roadmap und hältst sie am Leben.
  • Du durchdringst die explore-Plattform inhaltlich: Agentenlogik, Automatisierungskonzepte, Möglichkeiten und Grenzen und bringst Impulse aus dem KI-Markt direkt ins Produkt.

Team & Wissenstransfer

  • Du führst regelmäßige Gespräche mit Bestandskunden, verstehst ihre Arbeitsprozesse und erkennst, welche Anforderungen wirklich wichtig sind und welche nur laut.
  • Du übersetzt Kundenfeedback, Support-Erkenntnisse und Marktbeobachtungen in konkrete Produktentscheidungen.
  • Du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für eingehende Anforderungen und sorgst dafür, dass nichts verloren geht, alles bewertet wird und Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar sind.
  • Du nutzt KI-Tools selbstverständlich in deiner eigenen Arbeit: zur Recherche, Dokumentation, Analyse, Priorisierung und Automatisierung.

Zusammenarbeit & Steuerung

  • Du arbeitest täglich eng mit unseren Entwicklerinnen und Entwicklern zusammen: Sprint Planning, Refinements, Reviews; du bist dabei und bringst dich inhaltlich ein.
  • Du beantwortest Rückfragen des Teams schnell und verbindlich, nimmst Ergebnisse ab und stellst sicher, dass sie den definierten Akzeptanzkriterien entsprechen.
  • Du verstehst technische Zusammenhänge gut genug, um sinnvolle Abwägungen zwischen Aufwand und Nutzen zu treffen.
  • Du planst Demos vor Kunden und Stakeholdern und führst diese direkt im Produkt auch selbst aus.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im Software- oder Tech-Umfeld und weißt, wie agile Produktentwicklung in der Praxis funktioniert.
  • Eine Zertifizierung als Product Owner ist wünschenswert, aber kein Muss.
  • Du hast ein solides Verständnis von Softwareentwicklung und KI-Konzepten. Ein Informatikstudium oder eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker ist wünschenswert, aber nicht zwingend. Entscheidend ist, dass du mit dem Entwicklungsteam auf Augenhöhe kommunizieren kannst.
  • Du verstehst, wie LLMs, Agenten und Automatisierungssysteme funktionieren; nicht zwingend auf Code-Ebene, aber konzeptionell sicher genug, um Produktentscheidungen darauf zu gründen.
  • Du kannst gut zuhören, präzise zusammenfassen und Anforderungen so formulieren, dass sie das Team direkt umsetzen kann.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, priorisierst klar und verlierst auch bei vielen parallelen Themen nicht den Überblick.
  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf allen Ebenen: mit Kunden, Entwicklern und der Geschäftsführung gleichermaßen und verwendest jeweils die richtige Ansprache.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind Voraussetzung; Englisch ist im technischen Kontext selbstverständlich.
  • Wir wünschen uns jemanden, der hauptsächlich bei uns vor Ort ist. Mindestens 3 von 5 Tagen in unserem Büro in Pfaffenhofen. Remote-Tage sind selbstverständlich möglich und Teil unserer Arbeitsweise.

Benefits

  • Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag mit 30 Tagen Urlaub.
  • Flexibles Arbeiten und familienfreundliche Arbeitszeitgestaltung.
  • Ein kollegiales, wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld mit viel Raum für eigene Ideen.
  • Budget für Weiterbildung und die Tools, die du brauchst.
  • Du gestaltest aktiv mit, wohin sich explore entwickelt - mit echtem Einfluss auf Produktvision und Roadmap.
  • Du arbeitest an einer Plattform am Puls der aktuellen KI-Entwicklung und hast damit Einfluss auf Architektur und Produktrichtung.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Schick uns:

  • Deinen Lebenslauf.
  • Optional: Nachweis deiner PO-Zertifizierung.
  • Optional: Ein kurzes Beispiel, wie du eine komplexe Kundenanforderung in konkrete User Stories übersetzt hast. Das interessiert uns mehr als ein klassisches Anschreiben.

Fragen? Wir melden uns schnell.

Product Manager – Compliance

Help Shape the Future of AI Compliance in Financial Services

Aveni is redefining how financial institutions use AI. We build production-ready agentic systems that reshape how banks, advisers, and financial services firms operate, replacing fragmented processes with intelligent, end-to-end workflows. Recognized as Fintech of the Year for two consecutive years and awarded Best Specialist Technology Service at the Professional Adviser Awards 2025, we are backed by leading investors and supported by major financial institutions as we scale rapidly amid accelerating AI adoption in financial services.

 

Our platform enables some of the UK’s largest financial institutions to deploy AI safely in FCA-regulated environments, powering everything from compliance monitoring to AI-driven adviser guidance.

 

We are seeking a Product Manager – Assurance to play a central role in Aveni’s Assurance portfolio: products that help financial services firms govern, test, and assure AI agents and human interactions across the customer journey.

 

The Role

This role is primarily focused on Agent Approve, Aveni’s pre-deployment simulation and testing product, with additional responsibility for Detect, our post-interaction compliance assessment product.

 

Agent Approve is a growth-stage product operating in a dynamic regulatory environment. You will own the product from discovery through commercial readiness, helping define Aveni’s position in an emerging market.

 

This is a hands-on, high-ownership product role. You will collaborate closely with the Head of Assurance Products on strategy and roadmap direction while independently driving discovery, prioritisation, delivery, and go-to-market readiness. You will work with engineering, design, customer success, marketing, and commercial teams to turn complex customer and regulatory problems into clear, valuable, and shippable product outcomes.

 

You are well suited to this role if you enjoy operating in ambiguity, can bring structure to complex problem spaces, and possess the judgement to prioritize effectively, distinguishing what matters, what can wait, and what needs validation before building.

 

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own the Agent Approve and Detect product roadmaps from problem discovery and opportunity sizing through prioritisation, delivery, and launch readiness.

  • Lead continuous discovery with customers, prospects, and internal stakeholders, developing an evidence-based view of market direction and urgent problem areas.

  • Translate ideas and customer problems into low- and high-fidelity prototypes to validate assumptions early, reduce delivery risk, and accelerate decision-making.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering and design to convert strategy into executable delivery plans, maintain a prioritized backlog, and support squads through delivery.

  • Build strong relationships across engineering, commercial, customer success, and marketing, serving as a trusted voice on what we are building, why it matters, and how it supports Aveni's Assurance portfolio.

  • Stay current with industry trends, regulatory developments, and competitor activity in financial services compliance, QA technology, and AI assurance, ensuring product decisions are grounded in market context.

  • Use data and metrics to inform prioritization, define product KPIs, and measure the success of features and capabilities.

 

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager in a B2B SaaS environment, ideally owning a roadmap from discovery to delivery.

  • Domain expertise in financial services, compliance, risk, or regulatory technology, and experience leading stakeholder discovery and translating insights into product strategy.

  • Strong product judgement, clear communication skills, and confidence in shaping problem spaces, defining direction, defending prioritization decisions, and explaining trade-offs to diverse audiences.

  • Analytical rigor, comfort using data to guide decisions, and ability to build trusted relationships with engineers, designers, and senior commercial stakeholders.

  • Self-directed, proactive individuals comfortable in early-stage or ambiguous product environments where the path is not fully defined.

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI-powered products, analytics, or model-driven tooling; familiarity with FCA regulatory frameworks, Consumer Duty, or conduct risk.

  • Exposure to pre-deployment testing, quality assurance, or compliance workflows.

  • Experience writing compelling product narratives for commercial or go-to-market purposes, especially relevant for the growth-stage nature of Agent Approve.

 

Why Join Aveni?

You will work on complex and meaningful challenges at the intersection of AI, regulation, and financial services. You will help shape a product category that is growing in importance as financial institutions move from experimenting with AI to deploying it safely, responsibly, and at scale. You will have real ownership, visibility, and the opportunity to influence both product direction and market positioning during a pivotal stage of Aveni’s growth.

 

Benefits at Aveni

  • Remote-first working across the UK

  • Company-wide offsites and regular in-person gatherings

  • Work abroad policy

  • Optional Personal Development Plan

  • Flexible benefits platform for selecting the benefits that matter most to you

  • Life insurance, income protection, critical illness cover, and pension with up to 5% matched employer contribution

  • Private health and dental care

jobs.title: Product Manager - Wealth
jobs.description:
About the job

Aveni is redefining how financial institutions use AI. We build real, production-ready agentic systems that reshape how banks, advisers and financial services firms operate, replacing fragmented processes with intelligent, end-to-end workflows. We've been recognised as Fintech of the Year for two consecutive years and awarded Best Specialist Technology Service at the Professional Adviser Awards 2025. Backed by leading investors and commercially supported by major financial institutions, we're scaling quickly as adoption of AI in financial services accelerates.

 

Our Wealth platform helps financial advice firms transform how advisers and paraplanners work, using AI to automate documentation, improve compliance and streamline client servicing. From meeting summaries and document generation to compliance file checking and workflow automation, we're helping firms deliver a better experience for both advisers and their clients.

We're looking for a Product Manager – Wealth to lead the evolution of Aveni Assist, our flagship AI-powered platform for financial advice firms.

 

The role

 

This role is responsible for the strategy, roadmap and delivery of Aveni Assist, driving its continued evolution across core adviser workflows including meeting summaries, document generation, Letters of Authority, fact finds and compliance file checking.

 

Unlike an early-stage product, Aveni Assist already has an established customer base and a strong market presence. Your focus will be on scaling the product through continuous improvement—enhancing customer workflows, increasing adoption and satisfaction, and delivering measurable value that drives retention and growth.

 

This is a hands-on, high-ownership product role. You'll work closely with the Head of Product (Wealth) on product strategy while independently leading customer discovery, roadmap prioritisation, delivery and release planning. You'll collaborate with Engineering, Design, Customer Success and Commercial teams to ensure we're solving the right problems and delivering the highest-value outcomes.

 

We're looking for someone who enjoys understanding complex customer needs, making evidence-based decisions and building products that customers genuinely value.

 

What you'll be doing

 

  • You'll own the Aveni Assist roadmap end-to-end, balancing investment between new capabilities, product quality and platform improvements to maximise customer and commercial impact.

  • You'll lead continuous discovery with advisers, paraplanners, compliance teams and prospects, building a deep understanding of customer workflows and translating insight into product decisions.

  • You'll rapidly validate ideas using prototypes, customer research and experimentation, reducing delivery risk before committing engineering effort.

  • You'll own beta programmes for new capabilities, working closely with customers to gather structured feedback and determine when features are ready for general release.

  • You'll partner closely with Engineering and Design to translate strategy into clear delivery plans, maintaining a healthy backlog and ensuring features are released with a high standard of quality.

  • You'll build strong relationships across Engineering, Customer Success, Commercial and Marketing, acting as a trusted voice for the product and ensuring customer insight informs decision-making across the business.

  • You'll use customer feedback, usage analytics and product metrics to guide prioritisation, measure success and continually improve the product.

  • You'll stay informed about industry trends, adviser technology, AI developments and FCA regulation, ensuring Aveni Assist continues to lead the market.

 

What we're looking for

 

  • We're looking for someone with a proven track record as a Product Manager in a B2B SaaS environment, ideally with experience scaling an established product by improving customer satisfaction, adoption and retention.

  • You'll have demonstrable experience leading customer discovery, translating customer insight into product decisions and working closely with Engineering and Design to deliver high-quality software.

  • You'll have excellent product judgement, strong communication skills and the confidence to make difficult prioritisation decisions, balancing customer needs with commercial objectives.

  • You'll be analytically rigorous, comfortable using both qualitative and quantitative data to inform decisions, and capable of building trusted relationships across technical and commercial teams.

  • We're particularly interested in people who are proactive, self-directed and passionate about improving products through continuous iteration and customer feedback.

 

Nice to have

 

  • Experience with AI-powered products or machine learning technologies would be valuable, as would experience within financial services, wealth management or other regulated industries.

  • Knowledge of FCA Consumer Duty, adviser technology platforms or wealth management workflows would be advantageous, but isn't essential.

  • Experience running beta programmes, defining quality standards for AI-generated outputs or contributing to go-to-market activities would also be beneficial.

 

Why join Aveni?

 

You’ll work on genuinely difficult and meaningful problems at the intersection of AI, regulation and financial services.

 

You’ll help shape a product category that is becoming increasingly important as financial institutions move from experimenting with AI to deploying it safely, responsibly and at scale.

 

You’ll have real ownership, visibility and the opportunity to influence both product direction and market positioning at an important stage of Aveni’s growth.

jobs.description:
Agora Industry

Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you!
Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries.  Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a
 
Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin 
 
You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams.


Your responsibilities include

  • Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR).
  • Analysing biomass supply costs, availability and potentials for different agriculture and forestry products across multiple geographies, taking into account competing uses in different sectors and market implications. 
  • Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms
  • Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks.  
  • Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics. 
  • Supporting stakeholder engagement with policymakers, industry, civil society, funders, among others, to inform discussions around biomass applications across different industry sectors.
  • Pro-actively contributing to building partnerships and working closely with network partners across the globe. 
  • Liaising with expert colleagues across the Agora Think Tanks (including Agora Agriculture) to facilitate their contributions to projects and knowledge sharing across different regions.
  • Actively contributing to internal discussions.
  • Managing subcontractors including preparing agreements and work plans, supervising and guiding project progress, and managing the quality of deliverables.
  • As Project Officer, the focus is on contributing to the technical management of specific projects with smaller budget, largely independent research, contributing to the conceptualisation and development of complex topics, and of project-related reporting and communication. 
  • As Project Manager, the focus is on technical management and responsibility for specific projects with smaller budgets, independent comprehensive research, conceptualisation and development of complex topics, technical supervision of students and interns, and project-related reporting and communication.


We are looking for

  • A Master’s degree in energy, environmental engineering or forestry/agriculture engineering, natural sciences, renewable energies, agricultural economist, or similar

  • A proven track record and expertise in biomass supply cost, transport logistics and conversion technologies.

  • Familiarity with agricultural systems and ideally forest systems in different world regions is a plus. 
  • Good background understanding of industrial transformation is a plus.
  • Experience with Life-Cycle Assessment is a plus.

  • Strong networking skills and the ability to engage with business, industry associations, research partners and policy makers.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager für digitale Verwaltungsprojekte - Migration und Inneres (all genders)
jobs.description:
Über ]init[

Du möchtest die Gesellschaft von morgen mitgestalten? Dann bist du bei ]init[ richtig. Denn unsere digitalen Lösungen sind für Menschen gemacht und haben gesellschaftliche Relevanz. Klingt spannend? Dann steig ein und arbeite gemeinsam mit über 1.400 ]init[s in interdisziplinären Teams an unseren sieben Standorten – oder flexibel von überall in Deutschland aus.


Deine Mission bei ]init[

Du willst Digitalisierung dort vorantreiben, wo sie gesellschaftlich wirklich zählt? Als Senior Project Manager (all genders) gestaltest und steuerst du anspruchsvolle digitale Verwaltungsprojekte rund um Migration & Inneres. Du bringst Kund:innen, Fachlichkeit und Technologie zusammen und machst aus komplexen Anforderungen digitale Lösungen, die in der Praxis funktionieren.


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Du realisierst anspruchsvolle IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekte von gesellschaftlicher Relevanz mit besonderem Fokus auf die Fachthemen Migration & Inneres – agil oder hybrid.
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Projekte über die gesamte Projektlaufzeit und steuerst Scope, Time, Budget, Qualität und Risiken.
  • Du arbeitest mit interdisziplinäre Projektteams, in unterschiedlichen technologischen Kontexten – von digitalen Verwaltungsleistungen und Fachanwendungen über Content- und Formular-Management-Systeme bis hin zu individuellen IT-Lösungen zusammen und sorgst für eine strukturierte und verlässliche Zusammenarbeit innerhalb des Projekts.
  • Als zentrale Schnittstelle koordinierst du interne und externe Stakeholder und arbeitest eng mit unseren Kund:innen aus der öffentlichen Verwaltung zusammen. Gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams übersetzt du die Anforderungen unserer Kund:innen in tragfähige IT-Lösungen und digitale Prozesse und begleitest deren Umsetzung von der Konzeption bis zum erfolgreichen Go-live.
  • Du begleitest unsere Kund:innen bei Fragestellungen rund um die digitale Transformation und erkennst dabei auch Potenziale für die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Projekte und Lösungen.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement von  Entwicklungs- oder Digitalisierungsprojekten und kannst Projekte eigenständig und Ende-zu-Ende steuern.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Steuerung interdisziplinärer Projektteams und übernimmst sicher Verantwortung für Scope, Budget, Time,  Qualität und Risiken.
  • Idealerweise bringst du bereits Erfahrung mit Digitalisierungsprojekten der öffentlichen Verwaltung und/oder einen fachlichen Bezug zu den Themen Migration & Inneres mit.
  • Du kennst und schätzt die Zusammenarbeit mit externen Kund:innen und verstehst Projektmanagement als kundenorientierte Delivery-Rolle und bewegst dich mit deinem Kommunikationsgeschick souverän auf unterschiedlichen Ebenen der Projektorganisation.
  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit agilen und/oder klassischen Projektmethoden. Erfahrung mit skalierten agilen Vorgehensweisen oder hybriden Projekt-Set-ups ist ein Plus.
  • Idealerweise verfügst du über eine relevante Projektmanagement- oder Agile-Zertifizierung, z. B. PRINCE2, PMI, Scrum PSM/PSPO
  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium bildet die fachliche Grundlage für deine Tätigkeit bei uns.
  • Du bringst sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit.


Das bieten wir dir

  • Because we care: 30 Urlaubstage und Workation innerhalb der EU schaffen Freiraum für Erholung und neue Perspektiven. So lassen sich Beruf und Privatleben gut miteinander verbinden.
  • Work with us: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und Teilzeitmodelle ermöglichen dir, Arbeit und Alltag passend zu gestalten – immer abgestimmt mit deinem Team und deinen Projekten.
  • Learn with us: Mit der ]init[ Academy, Trainings, Zertifizierungen und bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch entwickelst du dich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Grow with us: Profitiere von bereichsübergreifendem Wissensaustausch und entwickle dich gemeinsam mit deinen Kolleg:innen kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Ride with us: JobRad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss und weitere Mobility Benefits unterstützen dich dabei, flexibel und nachhaltig unterwegs zu sein.
  • Start with us: Welcome Week, strukturiertes Onboarding und Patenschaften sorgen für einen gelungenen Einstieg und helfen dir, schnell im Team und deinen Projekten anzukommen.


Werde Teil des Teams

Gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft – in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit, remote oder im Office.
Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.
Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit sind für uns selbstverständlich. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit Behinderung und Gleichstellung begrüßen wir ausdrücklich.
 
Da uns und unseren Kund:innen Sicherheit wichtig ist, kann je nach Position nach einer Zusage eine vertrauliche Sicherheitsüberprüfung erforderlich sein.


Recruiter

Anne Kroll

jobs.title: Senior Product Design Engineer
jobs.description:
At Rohlik Group, we are building the future of e-grocery for over a million active customers across the Czech Republic, Germany, Austria, Hungary, and Romania. We own our entire technology stack — from storefronts and apps to automated fulfillment centers and last-mile logistics.

Within the Customer Experience (CUEX) domain, we own every touchpoint a customer interacts with, from the homepage to checkout and real-time order tracking across web, iOS, and Android. Our five storefronts run on a single product spine with localized content, pricing, and brand layers. We operate as a deliberately tight-knit, high-performing team where a Product Owner, Engineering Manager, Tech Lead, two Product Designers, and a dedicated full-stack engineering team ship fast, iterate constantly, and take full ownership of the end-to-end user journey.

Most interface failures in e-commerce aren’t layout issues — they are communication problems: what is said, in what order, and on which screen. As Senior Product Design Engineer, you will own the end-to-end design of all customer-facing surfaces across five markets. You will also manage our design system, Maia (our AI shopping assistant), and provide the design guidance that powers our automated coding workflows.

Why this role is exciting

  • High-impact Group scope: Design every customer-facing touchpoint across web, iOS, and Android for five international markets, impacting millions of orders.

  • True end-to-end ownership: Lead the complete lifecycle of product design — from initial problem definition and customer research to shipped A/B tests and real-world performance analysis.

  • AI-first execution: Rohlik is an AI-first company. You’ll own the interface design for Maia, our AI shopping assistant, and build the structured design system guidance used by AI coding agents to generate on-brand code without hand-coding interfaces.

  • Direct customer engagement: Lead user research and usability testing sessions directly with real shoppers, rather than commissioning external agencies or receiving filtered insights.

  • High accountability, low overhead: Work in a small, autonomous team where design decisions move straight to production and work that doesn't deliver measured impact is honestly reverted.

What you will own and deliver

  • Customer Surfaces: Own the end-to-end design and UX strategy across web, iOS, and Android for all core journey stages: homepage, search & browse, product pages, basket, slot selection, checkout, and order tracking.

  • Design System as a Product: Own component architecture, design tokens, patterns, and documentation, ensuring our coding agents have precise design guidance to generate accurate interfaces.

  • AI Experience Design: Define the interaction patterns for Maia (our AI shopping assistant), governing when it intervenes, how it presents information, and how it hands over to human support.

  • Experimentation & Analysis: Drive hypotheses, prototype rapidly, and evaluate A/B test results objectively — scaling successful experiments and sunsetting features that miss target performance.

  • Direct User Research: Conduct qualitative interviews, usability tests, and field research directly with customers to continuously uncover friction points.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with the Product Owner, Engineering Manager, Tech Lead, and your peer product designer, while providing design input to Commercial, Marketing, and Operations.

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years of experience designing consumer-facing digital products with a strong portfolio of shipped work across both web and native mobile (iOS and Android).

  • Advanced Figma & Design System expertise: Deep, hands-on experience building, scaling, and architecting multi-platform design systems at the token and component level.

  • Data-fluent mindset: Ability to read and rigorously interpret A/B testing data, distinguishing genuine impact from vanity metrics.

  • Fluency with AI tooling: Practical experience integrating AI tools into modern design, prototyping, and design system workflows, along with a clear view of where conversational AI adds real interface value.

  • User research expertise: Demonstrated experience designing, running, and analyzing qualitative usability sessions directly with end users.

  • Strong product reasoning: Excellent communication skills in English (C1 level or above), with the ability to articulate the strategic and behavioral rationale behind design decisions.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience designing production-grade AI or assistant-driven interfaces.

  • Experience contributing directly to code at the component or token level.

  • Background in e-commerce, quick-commerce, online grocery, or last-mile delivery.

  • First-hand familiarity with how German customers shop.

  • Fluency in German or Czech.

What’s in it for you

  • Fair pay, transparent, stable compensation A strong fixed salary with clear rules. No bonus politics. Great work is rewarded openly and fairly.

  • Good food options, fresh, every day Enjoy subsidised meals/fresh food options in the office and regular refreshments like drinks, fruit, and snacks that keep you energized.

  • Life beyond work, hybrid work & real flexibility Three days in the office and the rest where it works best for you. Take time off when you need it with paid vacation days above statutory and flexible scheduling.

  • Grow with Knuspr every day - we move fast, and so can you. Learn, experiment, and take ownership from day one. Every challenge is a chance to grow.

  • Recognition & community - Your impact is seen and appreciated. You can celebrate colleagues through Bonusly peer-recognition credits and feel supported by a team that works hard and wins together.

  • Health & wellbeing - Access to our UNIQA private insurance option and supportive wellbeing culture, keeping you healthy inside and outside of work.

  • Mobility & convenience - Company car available for selected management-level roles and fuel support for regular WH travel.

  • Premium membership - Free Knuspr Premium membership with exclusive benefits.

  • Referral rewards - Recommend great people and get rewarded through our group referral program.

  • Team spirit - We organize team events, celebrations, and moments to connect because work is better when we win together.

#LI-ML1 #Knuspr

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000).

We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 80 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world.

Product Manager

€70K – €100K | Offers Equity

At Almedia, you’ll:

  • Own way more, way earlier — you’ll be trusted with responsibility fast.

  • Push harder, get further — this isn’t a 9–5. We highly reward intensity.

  • Join a rare environment — you will work with ambitious high-speed, high-ownership people.

  • Fully present — we’re 5 days a week in the office to build the energising momentum we need.

Freecash is the product. Almedia is the engagement engine behind it: the smartest way for mobile game studios to turn high-potential users into high-value ones. We're the leader in our category, profitable, and now expanding into new verticals to capture a much bigger market.

We're hiring a Product Manager to join the team and own real outcomes. You won't be running the whole roadmap on day one. You'll own the results of the projects you take on, have a real say in where the roadmap goes, and take on as much as you can carry. The more you can own, the more we'll hand you.

If you think like a founder, get energy from hard problems, and want to dig into data and turn it into something worth building, keep reading.

What you'll own

You won't be handed a list of tickets. You'll be handed problems and trusted to solve them.

  • The outcomes of your projects, not just the tasks. You own the result of the work you take on, from the problem all the way to shipped impact to millions of daily active users.

  • A real say in the roadmap. You bring ideas, push back, and heavily influence what we build and why.

  • Room to make the call. You'll own your decisions without waiting for sign-off on everything. We back conviction, and a bet that doesn't land is a lesson, not a mark against you.

  • As much ownership as you can carry. We hand more to the people who prove they can run with it. Show us, and your scope grows fast.

What you'll bring

  • You think like a founder. You operate like an owner: figuring out what matters, making the call with incomplete information, and getting it done without waiting to be told.

  • You live in the data. You don't ask the analyst what the chart says. You dig in yourself, follow the thread, and come back with the insight nobody else found. Hungry to get hands-on with tools like Amplitude, Hex, and Looker.

  • You go deep and think wide. Data tells you what to solve. Creativity decides how. You explore a few ways to crack a problem before committing, because the obvious answer is rarely the best one.

  • You prioritize and you ship. You pick the few things that matter right now and drive them from idea to launch. Strong bias for action.

  • You communicate and align. You bring developers, data, design, and business development with you without slowing down.

  • Impact. We don't count years in a PM title. If you spent two years building your own company and one year in product, that counts. We care about what you've built and the impact you've had.

What puts you ahead

These aren't requirements, but they're the patterns we keep seeing in people who thrive here.

  • You founded a company, and now you want to go all-in on product. This is golden to us. You know what it means to own an outcome with no one to hand it off to, and you'd rather pour that energy into building product than into anything else right now.

  • You've worked in a fast-moving startup. Bonus if you were there through real growth. Shifting priorities and building the plane mid-flight feel normal to you.

  • You want to grow fast. You're here to do the best work of your career so far, and you'll take on everything you can handle to get there.

Why Almedia? 🚀

  • Own Our Growth: We offer all Berlin-based employees equity in Almedia to truly be a part of our success.

  • Scale With Almedia: Grow alongside a startup that has been profitable from day one.

  • Central Berlin Office: Work from a fully-stocked modern office built for collaboration, accessible from all around Berlin.

  • Other Benefits: Transport subsidy, breakfasts and lunches, language learning, Urban Sports Club, and more.

We believe in fostering talent, evaluating all skill levels during the hiring process, and providing a clear path for growth. Almedia is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace and celebrate diversity, and encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Compensation: €70K – €100K • Offers Equity

jobs.title: Project Manager & Functional Consultant
jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Product Management organization, working with the Delivery Promise team. This is one of those parts of Wolt's business that people don't always realize the complexity of. Logistics is absolutely integral to Wolt, and doing it well can mean the difference between delivering blissful customer experiences efficiently and profitably vs. operational nightmares and a cacophony of late deliveries. 

The Delivery Promise team is in the Courier & Logistics Product group at Wolt. We're driving the future with estimates that fuel our growth, flywheel, shaping shopping decisions and streamlining deliveries. Our goal: boost Wolt's growth and profitability by delivering reliable, precise time estimates to customers and partners worldwide. In a nutshell, the team is responsible for crafting accurate and reliable time estimates that form a key part of the pre-checkout purchase experience for our consumers, right from discovery to checkout. We employ advanced machine learning models and innovative tools to craft delivery estimates experienced by consumers across all business lines for Wolt.   

As the Product Manager for the Delivery Promise team, your role will be integral in ensuring that we provide the best delivery estimates for our consumers while balancing the operational impact of fulfilling deliveries against the promised estimates. You will be contributing significantly to Wolt's goal of delightful customer experiences. 

Join us in shaping the future of delivery, where every delivery is an opportunity for delight and loyalty.

Our humble expectations

You could come to this role from various backgrounds, but ideally, you bring:

  • Plenty of previous experience as a Product Manager 
  • It's a plus for you if you have a background in Machine Learning or Data Science, since you would be focused on optimizing our estimates across markets and consumer cohorts.  
  • Proven track record in building products influencing cross-functional teams, including engineering, data, design, and operations.
  • High ownership and collaborative capabilities, making thoughtful decisions, and focusing on product details to ensure execution aligns with the vision.
  • Strong ability to define, execute, and measure meaningful OKRs, ensuring alignment with company-wide goals and fostering bottom-up alignment from your team.
  • Ability to focus on the bigger picture, creating solutions that benefit couriers, operations, and customer experiences across the organization.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, able to work effectively with diverse internal teams and external partners, while confidently engaging with leadership in a high-visibility role.

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

The compensation will be a negotiable combination of monthly pay and DoorDash RSUs. The latter makes it exceptionally easy to be excited about our company growing and doing well, as you'll own a piece of the pie.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche.

Das wäre ein Plus

  • Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel.

Aufgabenbereich

Was du bei uns bewegst

  • Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience.

Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern.

Nous accompagnons les salariés avec des sessions individuelles, une application de self-care et un outil de micro-learning intégré à Slack et Teams.
Nous aidons les équipes RH avec une interface de data analytics automatisée et des conseils personnalisés d'experts.
Où en sommes-nous actuellement ? Depuis décembre 2019, plus de 400 entreprises, dont L'Oréal, Spendesk et Engie, ont rejoint Moka.Care, bénéficiant à plus de 300 000 collaborateurs dans le monde entier. Nous avons levé 17,5 millions d'euros auprès d'investisseurs et de business angels de premier rang.
Notre croyance fondamentale : l'excellence in care est notre obsession.
La culture d'entreprise, ce n'est pas juste des jolis mots que l'on affiche sur les murs. Nous incarnons des valeurs tangibles : l’empathie comme fondement, un optimisme insatiable, une responsabilité partagée et de l’agilité.

Au sein de l’équipe Marketing & Communication, et sous la responsabilité de Pauline, Responsable Communication & Marketing Produit, tu auras pour objectifs principaux de :

  • Augmenter l’adoption de notre produit par nos utilisateurs (les salariés des entreprises clientes de Moka.Care) en créant des visuels percutants et en accompagnant nos consultants sur le terrain.
  • Développer la notoriété de Moka.Care, en contribuant à des campagnes créatives et impactantes, qui valorisent notre expertise et notre raison d’être.
Tu travailleras en collaboration très étroite avec nos consultants qui accompagnent nos clients au quotidien.
 

👉 Tes futures missions 

Engagement clients

  • Animer notre communauté de DRH via des événements premium : Club RH (Take.Care Connect), soirée d'été, webinars clients centrés sur le produit Moka...
  • Partager les nouvelles fonctionnalités et nouvelles offres à nos clients via des newsletters, des emails et des communications dans la plateforme RH.

Engagement utilisateurs

Notoriété et thought leadership

  • Rédiger des communiqués de presse et des tribunes pour renforcer la visibilité médiatique de Moka.Care.
  • Produire des contenus (interviews vidéos, pages du site, slides...) pour valoriser nos histoires clients.
  • Participer à l'élaboration de campagnes de marque et d'actions d'influence pour faire rayonner notre expertise auprès de décideurs stratégiques.
 
L'entraide est très importante chez Moka.
De temps en temps, tu prêteras main forte aux autres membres de l'équipe Marketing & Communication sur des projets divers, par exemple : aider à l’organisation d’événements et webinaires de prospection, créer des contenus pour le blog, le site ou Linkedin...

📇 Tu es la personne idéale si

  • Tu es à l'aise à l'oral, et sais adapter ton discours à des interlocuteurs corporate exigeants.

🤩 Nous prenons soin de toi
