jobs.description:
What We’re All About.

Quantexa is a global leader in AI-powered Decision Intelligence. As one of the UK's fastest-growing tech companies, we're on a mission to help organisations make better, more trusted decisions. As we continue our rapid global expansion, we are looking for a commercially minded and technically strong finance professional to join our dynamic finance team.

At Q, we’re looking for people who share that vision. People like you.

The opportunity.

What you’ll be doing.

We are seeking an experienced Financial Lead in processes and control to help modernise and scale a global finance function operating across a complex, multi-entity, multi-jurisdiction environment.

Reporting to the VP Finance, you will lead initiatives that improve the effectiveness, efficiency and scalability of Finance through process redesign, technology enablement, data governance and operational excellence.

This role sits at the intersection of finance operations, systems, data and business performance. You will be responsible for transforming core finance processes, improving controls, implementing enabling technologies and ensuring that transformation initiatives deliver measurable and sustainable business value.

Unlike a traditional programme management role, success will not be measured solely by project delivery. You will be expected to challenge assumptions, validate outcomes and ensure that process and system changes translate into tangible improvements in close efficiency, reporting quality, control effectiveness and decision-making.

You will play a key role in consolidating information from a diverse systems landscape, improving data quality and governance, and helping establish a single source of truth for financial and operational reporting.

What you’ll bring.

Finance Process Transformation & Operational Excellence

  • Assist in the design and implementation of the Finance Target Operating Model (TOM), covering processes, systems and data, providing input and recommendations to support the overall TOM design.

  • Develop and maintain a transformation roadmap aligned to business objectives, operational efficiency, governance requirements and future compliance needs, including SOX readiness.

  • Analyse and redesign finance processes to improve productivity, control effectiveness and user experience.

  • Identify control gaps, operational risks and process inefficiencies, developing practical and prioritised remediation plans.

  • Establish robust data governance, validation and reporting frameworks to improve the quality, consistency and reliability of financial information.

  • Map and optimise end-to-end transaction flows across multiple systems and data sources.

  • Support the creation of scalable reporting and analytics capabilities that provide meaningful operational and financial insight.

Finance Systems & Automation

  • Lead finance systems and automation projects from initial requirements through to implementation and post-go-live stabilisation.

  • Partner with Finance and Technology teams to evaluate, select and implement solutions that support future-state finance operations.

  • Drive automation opportunities across close processes, journal management, reconciliations, variance analysis and reporting.

  • Ensure data integrity, auditability and control considerations are embedded within all system and process changes.

  • Establish governance standards for financial data, system ownership and ongoing process maintenance.

Programme Delivery & Change Management

  • Apply disciplined project and programme management practices including planning, risk management, benefits tracking, stakeholder communication and delivery governance.

  • Define success measures and ensure transformation benefits are tracked, validated and sustained over time.

  • Build engagement and buy-in across the finance organisation by clearly communicating objectives, priorities and expected outcomes.

  • Support teams through process, technology and organisational change, ensuring successful adoption of new ways of working.

  • Translate complex finance, operational and technology challenges into clear and actionable implementation plans.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Partner with senior stakeholders across Finance, Technology, Legal, Operations and commercial functions to align transformation priorities with wider business objectives.

  • Act as a trusted advisor on finance process, controls, systems and operating model design.

  • Work alongside finance teams to resolve complex operational challenges, improve processes and implement best practices.

  • Provide regular reporting to senior leadership on programme progress, risks, benefits realisation and key transformation milestones.

  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement, accountability and operational excellence across the finance function.

Experience & Qualifications

Essential.

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, ICAS, or equivalent).

  • Proven experience operating at Head of Finance / Financial Controller level, with broad oversight of the full accounting cycle (AP through to management accounts).

  • Demonstrated experience with multi-GAAP statutory accounting across multiple entities/jurisdictions.

  • Deep understanding of controllership processes: financial close cycles, account reconciliation, consolidation, intercompany accounting, journal entry management, and statutory reporting.

  • Track record of successfully leading financial systems/process implementation projects (e.g. ERP implementation, close process redesign, close automation tooling).

  • Demonstrated ability to design and implement future-state close operating models covering process, automation, controls, data, and people.

  • Strong project management skills and experience, ideally with formal methodology exposure (e.g. Agile, Prince2, or similar).

  • Experience leading teams through significant change, with a genuine ability to bring people along on the journey.

  • Comfortable being hands-on and detail-oriented while also operating strategically.

Desirable.

  • Hands-on implementation or advisory experience with one or more close automation or EPM platforms (e.g. FloQast, BlackLine, OneStream, Prophix, or comparable).

  • Experience in a fast-growing, multi-entity, international business (SaaS/technology sector a plus).

  • Experience with modern finance/ERP systems (e.g. NetSuite, Workday, SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics) and reporting/automation tools.

  • Familiarity with the intersection between close quality, internal controls, and external audit.

  • Prior experience partnering with Legal, HR, and commercial teams on cross-functional finance matters.

  • PMP / PRINCE2 / Agile certification, or a Lean Six Sigma qualification.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realise your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognised and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. If you need any reasonable adjustments or accommodations, please let our Talent Acquisition Team know - we’re happy to assist.

No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
Senior Product Designer @ Secfix

Location: Remote (EMEA) · CET/CEST time zone

Hi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix.

How do you feel about owning a feature from the first customer conversation to the version that's live in production — writing the spec yourself, pairing closely with engineers through the build, and overseeing your design shipped in production exactly the way you designed it? If that sounds like the right shape of the job — designer who owns, not designer who hands off — read on.

I've spent most of my career believing the best designers aren't the ones with the prettiest Figma files. They're the ones who can frame a problem, write a spec, sit with engineers through the build, and own that what shipped is what they designed. Our founding product designer, Ghada, has been doing exactly that since we started. The engineering team has doubled, and we're shipping faster than we ever have. We're hiring the third designer because there's more good work to do than two people can handle — and we'd rather ship faster than slow down.


Why Secfix exists

Over 1.78 million SMBs in Europe need to comply with security frameworks — ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, SOC 2 — just to sell to enterprise customers. The process is manual, painful, and takes over a year. We automated it.

Our platform integrates with a company's full tech stack — AWS, Azure AD, Jira, GitLab, GCP, and more — automatically extracts compliance evidence, and guides teams to certification in weeks instead of months. Our fastest customer was certified in 4 weeks instead of the industry-standard 12+ months.

We've raised €17M in total (€12M Series A), backed by Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital. We're on a profitable trajectory, growing fast, and building the team that will take us to European market leadership.

This space is not threatened by AI; it's amplified by it. Compliance requires deep domain expertise combined with automation. Our new AI product (CISO AI) is just getting started, and there's a huge amount of product design work ahead: agentic workflows, intelligent evidence collection, context-aware policy generation, and more.

What we believe

Compliance software has historically been built like the audit it automates — heavy, defensive, ugly. We're building something else. The customer is a real person trying to ship audit-ready evidence on a Friday afternoon. The product should respect their time, automate the boring parts, and make the rest feel calm.

Quality is the product. Most of our category competes on feature lists. We compete on craft. A clear empty state, a sync that doesn't lie, a settings page that holds together at eleven permission tiers — these are the things customers feel before they can name them. Design at Secfix is not what wraps the product. It's most of what makes it work.

What the role is

We expect strong design skills, strong product thinking, and the ability to hold your own in a technical discussion. You work in a small team — usually with one or two engineers — and pair closely from the first prototype through to production. You own the project from beginning to end.

Alongside the features you ship, you do three things that make everyone else faster:

  • Maintain the components and patterns that make design fast.

  • Own how the team ships. We have no PMs. You write the specs, run the ticketing workflow, keep engineers unblocked.

  • Build the tools and skills — Cursor rules, design QA skills, prompt templates — that let engineers do good design work without you in the room.

The leverage is doing all four well. Doing only one is the wrong shape.

How we work

  • No PMs. Designers and engineers run product. You talk to customers, frame the problem, write the spec, decide what ships.

  • Small temporary teams. You plus one or two engineers per project. Whoever is closest to the problem leads.

  • Design leads the logic; engineering tests feasibility. You bring the V1. Engineers push back on what's expensive or risky, and start ahead with system design. They help spot edge cases. You adjust it fast. We get from v1 to v4 in a matter of hours or a few days.

  • Prototype-grade, not wireframes. Real components, real states, real copy. Sometimes an LLM-built prototype before Figma. The component library stays current because the speed of design depends on it.

  • Handoff is the beginning, not the end. You're in the engineering channel. You review the PR. You verify on production. Staging QA is the first gate, not the last.

  • In-sync culture with a thoughtful comms mindset. Loom for reviews, Notion for specs, quick loops in Gather where written comms don’t cut it, all happening in the same time zone. Teammates are reviewing things quickly. Engineers and designers spend under two hours in weekly meetings.

  • AI is part of the craft. We use Claude to pressure-test ideas, draft specs, surface edge cases, and write test cases. Not to skip thinking.

The first three months

  • Month 1. Ship your first design to production. Get into the codebase, the customer language, the way we write specs. Sit on customer calls.

  • Month 2. Own a full feature end-to-end. Customer conversations, problem framing, Figma, spec, engineer pairing, PR review, production verification.

  • Month 3 and beyond. Push the design system forward. Start building the tools and skills that make engineers faster at design. Improve the product design process. The bar is yours to defend.

Who you are

  • 8+ years designing B2B SaaS desktop applications as Staff/Principal Product Designer or similar. Dense interfaces — tables, filters, permissions, settings pages.

  • You've been the only designer, or one of two or three, in companies under 50 people at least once before. You know how to set the bar without a design org behind you.

  • Your portfolio is "I," not "we." You can name the engineer you paired with on each feature, the design decision you defended through the build, and what happened when the feature reached users.

  • You communicate clearly and concisely in English: in Slack, in docs and on a call.

  • You're fast in Figma with or without AI. You’re already in a serious relationship with LLMs.

  • You treat engineering feasibility as input, not a constraint. When an engineer says "three weeks, here's why," you find the version that's 80% as good and ships next week.

  • You're comfortable doing product work without the PM title.

  • You hear feedback and come back the next day with something better. You don't spend the hour in between defending the version that's already outdated.

Compensation

Salary + equity based on experience. The offered compensation depends on the individual's qualifications assessed during the interview process.

What we offer

  • Generous equity. Everyone is an owner.

  • 26 days holiday + local public holidays.

  • Comprehensive health insurance.

  • €1,000 annual personal development budget.

  • Remote workspace and co-working budget.

  • Latest equipment.

  • Team summits 1-2x per year. Recent ones: Alicante, Costa Brava, Austrian Alps, Milan.

  • Local hubs in Munich, Berlin, London. Visa support if you want to relocate.

Interview process

We aim to invite you to a first conversation within a week and give feedback after every stage.

  • Intro call with talent team (~45 min)

  • Portfolio conversation with product designer (~45 min)

  • Collaborative design task (compensated, a couple of hours over the span of 2-3 days)

  • Final interview with Grigory (~60 min)

Order may flex depending on availability. If you make it to the exercise and don't get an offer, we'll tell you specifically what got in the way.

Learn how we think and work

  • How we designed remote culture at Secfix

  • Thoughtful communication at Secfix

  • Building production-grade product with AI in 2026

  • Building what customers need, not what they ask for

  • Our zero-bug policy

  • Crafting quality that endures — Karri Saarinen's Config talk

We are an equal-opportunity employer and a remote-only company. We hire within EU time zones. We work in sync using Gather as our virtual office and don't support fully asynchronous work.

jobs.description:
Über uns

MEONDI ist Unternehmenspartner für Digitalisierung und neue Arbeitsstrukturen. Wir navigieren unsere Kunden ganzheitlich durch Innovations- und Transformationsprozesse sowie agile Produktentwicklungen.
Dabei legen wir unseren Fokus auf relevante Handlungsfelder wie Strategie, Leadership, Organisationsentwicklung, Prozesse, Software & CX. Als Berater, Umsetzer und Begleiter verbinden wir fachliche Expertise mit echter Umsetzung – projektbasiert, kundennah und mit dem Anspruch, nachhaltige Lösungen zu schaffen.

Du willst die Zukunft von MEONDI und unserer Kunden aktiv mitgestalten? Als Berater digitale Produktentwicklung & AI bist du bei uns nicht einfach Berater – du bist Mitgestalter echter Kundenlösungen.  Du arbeitest hands-on in digitalen Software-Produktteams unserer Kunden und bringst AI dorthin, wo sie die tägliche Arbeit wirksam besser macht. Dabei verbindest du agile Produktentwicklung, pragmatische Beratung und operative Umsetzung.  

Seit unserer Gründung steht MEONDI für technologische Exzellenz, unternehmerisches Denken und echte Partnerschaft auf Augenhöhe.  

Unser Anspruch: YOUR BUSINESS FUTURE READY.  

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine:n

Berater digitale Produktentwicklung & AI (a)


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du arbeitest in digitalen Software-Produktteams unserer Kunden mit und übernimmst eigenständig Themen und Arbeitspakete.

  • Du unterstützt Teams als Scrum Master oder in verwandten Rollen.

  • Je nach Rolle strukturierst, analysierst und formulierst Du Anforderungen und arbeitest eng mit Product Ownern, Business Analysts, Entwicklern, UX, Fachbereichen und weiteren Projektbeteiligten zusammen.

  • Du identifizierst sinnvolle AI-Anwendungsfälle in Produktentwicklung und Zusammenarbeit und erprobst und etablierst AI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen.

  • Du baust AI-Workflows, Automatisierungen oder agentische Lösungsansätze auf und hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und Methoden pragmatisch.

  • Du erkennst Risiken, Blockaden und Verbesserungspotenziale frühzeitig, bringst Lösungen voran und gibst zusätzliche Kundenbedarfe intern weiter.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du verfügst über relevante Berufserfahrung in digitalen Software- oder Produktentwicklungsteams (z.B. 3-6 Jahre)

  • Du hast Erfahrung als Scrum Master oder verwandten Rollen und verstehst digitale Produktentwicklung von der Anforderung bis zur Umsetzung.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit Backlogs, User Stories, Refinement, Planning und Release-Prozessen und nutzt Tools wie Jira, Confluence und Miro.

  • Du nutzt moderne AI-Werkzeuge regelmäßig, experimentierst mit AI-gestützten Workflows und erkennst sinnvolle Anwendungsmöglichkeiten.

  • Du verstehst technische Zusammenhänge ausreichend, um effektiv mit Entwicklern zusammenzuarbeiten.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch (C2) und Englisch (C1), übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen und bleibst auch bei wechselnden Anforderungen handlungsfähig.


Das kannst du von uns erwarten

Kultur & Zusammenarbeit
Bei MEONDI erwartet dich eine Kultur geprägt von Offenheit, Transparenz und Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe. Wir glauben an unternehmerisches Denken, Eigenverantwortung und daran, dass nachhaltige Lösungen nur im echten Dialog entstehen.

Eigenverantwortung & Vertrauen
Du erhältst den Freiraum, deine Aufgaben selbstständig zu gestalten. Wir setzen auf Vertrauen statt Mikromanagement und auf Ergebnisorientierung statt Präsenzkultur.

Flexibilität & Arbeitsmodell
Mobile Working ist bei uns gelebte Realität. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub ermöglichen dir, Beruf und Leben in Einklang zu bringen – ob remote, in einem unserer Hubs oder beim Kunden.

Professionelle Rahmenbedingungen
Wir statten dich mit hochwertiger technischer Ausstattung (MacBook, iPhone auch privat nutzbar) aus und schaffen klare, professionelle Projektstrukturen.

Weiterentwicklung & Wachstum
Individuelles Coaching, regelmäßige Austauschformate und transparente Quartalsmeetings mit Einblick in Strategie und Unternehmensentwicklung sorgen dafür, dass du fachlich wie persönlich wachsen kannst.

Gemeinschaft & Austausch
Unsere Hubs sind bewusst als Orte für Workshops, Reviews und Zusammenarbeit konzipiert. Wir schaffen Räume für echten Austausch, gemeinsames Lernen und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung.


Kontakt

Wenn du Verantwortung übernehmen, und mit uns zusammen die Zukunft von MEONDI gestalten möchtest, dann zögere nicht uns zu kontaktieren.

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

jobs.title: (Senior) Produkt Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Deine neue Rolle bei finway

Wir suchen ab sofort eine erfahrene und umsetzungsstarke Persönlichkeit als (Senior) Produkt Manager (m/w/d) für eine Elternzeitvertretung (erst einmal auf 2 Jahre befristet - potentielle unbefristete Anstellung nach dieser Zeit möglich).
In dieser Rolle übernimmst du das operative und strategische Produktmanagement. Du bildest die Brücke zwischen Softwareentwicklung, Design, Customer Success und Marketing und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Initiativen zielgerichtet und für unsere Kunden gewinnbringend umgesetzt werden.


Das sind Deine Aufgaben

Produktentwicklung & Agile Team-Führung

  • Agiles Arbeiten: Du steuerst das Entwicklerteam („Team Seal“) durch tägliche Dailies, zweiwöchentliche Sprint Plannings und Reviews inklusive Demos

  • Schnittstelle Dev: Du begleitest technische Umsetzungen eng (z. B. im Bereich KYB) und stimmst dich in Dev-Weeklies zu Architektur und technischer Ausrichtung ab

Cross-Functional Alignment & Kundenkontakt

  • Schnittstelle zu Go-To-Market & CS: Du arbeitest eng mit Customer Success (Enablement, Support-Sparring, Ticket-Eskalationen) und Product Marketing (Features, Positionierung) zusammen

  • Partner- & Kunden-Projekte: Du führst Workshops und Integrationen mit externen Partnern durch und begleitest Customer-Meetings, um Feedback einzuholen und komplexe Anwendungsfälle zu lösen

  • Sales Support & Webinare: Du unterstützt den Vertrieb bei Enterprise-Deals und konzipierst sowie hältst zweimonatliche Produkt-Webinare für unsere Kunden

Product Design, Specs & Testing

  • Konzeption & Architektur: Du entwirfst konkrete Produktlösungen (z. B. KI-gestützte Features) und schreibst präzise Anforderungsspezifikationen

  • Backlog- & Ticket-Management: Du priorisierst Sprints, organisierst den Backlog in enger Abstimmung mit CS und priorisierst Bug-Fixes

  • Qualitätssicherung: Du testest neue Funktionalitäten und Plattform-Komponenten eigenständig (insbes. spezialisierte Szenarien)

Release Management & Kommunikation

  • Interne & externe Release-Kommunikation: Du erstellst In-App-Mitteilungen (Intercom Series/Tooltips), verfasst Release Notes inkl. kurzer Video-Tutorials und informierst alle Stakeholder via Slack.

  • Dokumentation: Du stellst sicher, dass Helpcenter-Artikel durch CS stets auf dem neuesten Stand gehalten werden.


Das solltest Du mitbringen

  • Erfahrung: Mehrjährige fundierte Erfahrung als Product Manager (idealerweise im B2B-SaaS-, Fintech- oder PayTech-Umfeld)

  • Agiles Mindset: Verlässliche Routine in agilen Methoden (Scrum/Kanban), Erfahrung in der Führung von Sprint-Zeremonien sowie im Umgang mit Jira/Linear o. Ä.

  • Business Acumen & Strategisches Denken: Du verstehst das Geschäftsmodell hinter dem Produkt, behältst relevante KPIs im Blick und kannst Produktentscheidungen mit kommerzieller Logik und klarem Kundenwert begründen

  • Methodische Product Discovery: Du bist stark darin, Nutzerbedürfnisse und Marktpotenziale systematisch zu validieren - sei es durch Kundeninterviews, Datenanalysen oder Prototyping -, bevor Lösungen in die Entwicklung gehen

  • Verständnis für komplexe Systeme: Du kannst komplexe technische Konzepte (APIs, Partner-Integrationen, KI-Funktionen) in klare Anforderungen übersetzen

  • Starke Schnittstellenkompetenz: Du kommunizierst souverän mit Entwicklern, Partnern, Customer Success und C-Level-Stakeholdern.

  • Pragmatismus & Hands-on-Mentalität: Du hast kein Problem damit, selbst tief in Spezifikationen einzutauchen, Szenarien durchzutesten oder Support-Fälle zu lösen.

  • Kundenorientierung: Du bringst Erfahrung im Halten von Webinaren und in der Durchführung von Kunden-Interviews mit.

  • Sprachen: Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.


Das bieten wir Dir

  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten und Gestaltungsfreiräume sind bei uns selbstverständlich
  • Wir leben eine offene Unternehmenskultur mit flachen Hierarchien, in der Erfolge gemeinsam im Team gefeiert werden und uns alle motivieren
  • Unbegrenzte Urlaubstage, denn Du weißt am besten, wie viel Erholung Du brauchst
  • Faires Gehalt inkl. Unternehmensanteilen in Form von ESOPs
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events, um trotz 'remote first' den Zusammenhalt im Team zu stärken 
  • Hybrides Arbeiten und ein Office in der Nähe der Donnersbergerbrücke 
  • Die richtigen Tools für effizientes Arbeiten, u.a.: Jira/Confluence, Intercom, Startdeliver, GotoWebinar 


Lerne Dein zukünftiges Team kennen

Das finway-Team besteht aktuell aus 30 Kolleg:innen aus 10 verschiedenen Nationen, die alles dafür geben, Finanzprozesse einfacher zu machen. Wir sind eine Remote Company, wobei der Großteil des Teams an unserem Standort in München sitzt. In der Produkt Manager-Rolle arbeitest du direkt mit dem gesamten Engineering und Customer Success-Team zusammen und tauschst dich auch mit dem Sales und Marketing-Team hinsichtlich aktueller und neuer Strategien aus. Ein interaktiver Austausch im gesamten Team ist uns bei finway sehr wichtig. Jeder ist bei uns willkommen, ganz unabhängig von Herkunft, Geschlecht, Hautfarbe, sexueller Orientierung oder Geschlechtsidentität. Der Beitrag von jedem:r Einzelnen bringt uns bei finway voran und als Team können wir finway zu dem führenden Player in der ganzen Welt machen.
Unser gesamtes Team findest du auf unserem LinkedIn Profil. 


Kontakt

Klingt interessant? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung mit möglichem Einstiegstermin an unsere Senior People Operations Managerin Michelle Boy.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Driving projects at Sonam Inc

Sonam Inc operates in the professional services sector, delivering structured solutions within a 50 to 200-person organization based in Berlin. This fixed-term 12-month contract role exists to steer complex initiatives from kickoff to delivery, operating on a 40-hour work week with a 6-month probation period.

Your responsibilities

You will own project lifecycles end-to-end, aligning cross-functional teams and managing stakeholder expectations across all phases of delivery.

  • Define project scopes, resource allocations, and timelines to ensure predictable execution.

  • Identify operational bottlenecks and implement corrective measures before they impact delivery.

  • Facilitate communication between technical teams, client representatives, and internal leadership.

  • Track milestones and maintain documentation using standard project management frameworks.

What you bring

Candidates who match most of the following requirements are strongly encouraged to apply, even if you do not check every box.

  • Demonstrated experience managing complex projects within professional services or related environments.

  • Strong command of English, paired with clear written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to coordinate multiple workstreams concurrently without losing attention to detail.

  • Pragmatic problem-solving mindset focused on measurable outcomes.

Support and security

Life & disability insurance is provided to protect you and your dependents.

Compensation

The salary for this position ranges from EUR 5,200–6,800 per month.

Your first months at Sonam Inc

You will have taken on active project streams, mapped out current operational workflows, and established direct communication channels with your core teams. By month three, you will have shipped key milestones and identified critical areas for process refinement.

jobs.title: Junior Product Manager – MarTech
jobs.description:
Ready to build at the crossroads of Marketing Tech and Entertainment? 

JustWatch provides data-driven digital marketing for the global entertainment industry. We build internal tools that help our campaign managers automate workflows and unlock innovative capabilities in entertainment marketing.

We’re hiring a Junior Product Manager for our MarTech team. This role is perfect for someone who is highly organised and can create clarity in an unstructured environment.

 
 

What you will be doing
  • Ensuring weekly progress toward quarterly goals.
  • Testing new releases hands-on, verifying behaviour, tracking issues, and scheduling fixes.
  • Monitoring product metrics and system health, flagging issues early.
  • Using our internal automation tools to understand real user workflows.
  • Stepping in quickly when issues surface to help coordinate a resolution.
  • Taking ownership of smaller product areas as you grow.

    • What you will NOT be doing
  • Jira administration or ticket shuffling - we work lightweight, and we optimise for speed.
  • Make meetings for the sake of process or ceremony.
  • Wait for work to fall on your desk - you’ll know what needs to be prioritised next.

    • What we need from you
  • You’re comfortable working with unclear problems and incomplete information, and can create structure on your own.
  • You keep work moving: follow up, unblock, prioritise, and ensure things ship.
  • You ask the right questions to unlock core pain points and strategise solutions.
  • You organise work using simple tools (Docs, Sheets), not PM frameworks or Jira workflows.
  • You can write development-ready project documents with no AI fluff.
  • You understand MarTech fundamentals (campaign workflows, tracking, automation, integrations) and why they’re complex.
  • You’re data-strong: you explore datasets, can use BI tools (e.g. Lightdash), and conclude.
  • You’re comfortable working close to technical systems: reading logs, debugging issues, understanding APIs, and supporting automation.
  • You’ve shipped before - a dashboard, tool, workflow, script, automation, or project.

    • What we offer you
  • You'll have a direct impact on how the global marketing campaigns are run.
  • You’ll see immediately how improvements (and mistakes) affect our bottom line.
  • Incredible learning opportunity. You’ll work closely with the MarTech PM, developers, and founders who are actively involved in shaping the company.
  • A culture built on autonomy, trust, and continuous iteration - not corporate ladder climbing.
  • A team that deeply cares about delivering results.

    • If we caught your attention and you're eager to delve into our perspectives and thought processes, we recommend immersing yourself in our blog post, which elaborates on these subjects:

    • A company culture that really works
    • Audience as a Service
    • Or visit our blog here: https://www.justwatch.com/blog

    How to apply

    Just hit the apply button and leave us your CV, some basic info, and a short introduction that helps us get to know you. Tell us what motivates you, why you want to work at JustWatch, and how you think you can help us achieve our goals.

    Please only apply if you are genuinely interested. Copy-paste mass applications will receive a copy-paste rejection email. The same goes for applications that rely heavily on AI-generated content. We want to get to know you as a person first, not your prompts.

    If you have any questions, please reach out to our Talent Team via LinkedIn or apply directly through our jobs page.

    Research shows women apply when meeting 100% qualifications, men at 60%. JustWatch welcomes all candidates, especially women and marginalized groups. Apply, let's talk and explore if you're a great fit.

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
We want you!

SNK ist eine reine B2B-Digitalagentur mit über 20 Jahren Erfahrung. Wir entwickeln digitale Plattformen, Websites, Portale, Apps und individuelle Softwarelösungen für führende Industrieunternehmen sowie stark wachsende SaaS- und Tech-Companies. 

Unser Anspruch: Beratung, Konzept und Umsetzung aus einer Hand, mit Senior-Teams, hohem Qualitätsstandard und klarer Verantwortung. 

Als Senior Account Manager (m/w/d) bist du die zentrale Informations- und Kommunikationsdrehscheibe zwischen Geschäftsführung, Experten-Teams und Kunden 

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unsere wertvollsten Kundenbeziehungen, professionalisierst unser Account Management weiter und entwickelst unseren bestehenden Kundenstamm proaktiv zu neuem Wachstum. Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Geschäftsführung, Experten-Teams und Kunden bringst du dich bereits in der Vertriebsphase ein, erkennst Marktlücken und Potenziale frühzeitig und führst Kundenbeziehungen strategisch – von der Erstberatung über Workshops bis zum langfristigen Ausbau.


Deine Aufgaben:

  • Kundenführung: Du betreust eigenverantwortlich A-Potential-Accounts (sowie ausgewählte B-Accounts), steuerst deren Priorisierung, Ziel- und Maßnahmenplanung und erkennst ungenutzte Potenziale, um daraus neue Projekte anzustoßen und die Pipeline gezielt auszubauen. Bereits in der Pitch- und Angebotsphase gestaltest du Scope und Leistungsversprechen aktiv mit.

  • Beratung & Workshops: Du verantwortest Formate wie jährliche Kunden-Workshops und Reviews und berätst auf Basis der Zielsetzung, Budgets und internen Dynamiken deiner Kunden passgenau.

  • Schnittstelle & Enablement: Du bildest die Brücke zwischen Kunden, Geschäftsführung und Fachteams (z. B. UX, Creative, Digital Marketing) und hilfst Projektmanager:innen, Kundensignale richtig zu deuten und in die operative Arbeit zu übersetzen.

  • Risiko- & Eskalationsmanagement: Du erkennst kritische Kundensignale frühzeitig, klärst Eskalationen auf Entscheiderebene souverän und hältst den Projektteams den Rücken frei. 

  • Enger Sparringspartner der Geschäftsführung: Du berichtest regelmäßig zu Status, NRR, Kundenqualität und relevanten KPIs und treibst im engen Austausch die Weiterentwicklung unseres Account-Management-Systems voran.


Du bringst mit:

  • Fundierte Erfahrung im Senior / Lead Account Management: Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der strategischen Betreuung und Skalierung von B2B-Bestandskunden im Agentur- oder digitalen Beratungsumfeld.

  • Exzellentes Stakeholder-Management: Du baust ab Tag 1 Glaubwürdigkeit auf C-Level und Sponsorenebene auf und bewegst dich sicher auch in komplexen, konfliktbehafteten Kundensituationen.

  • Souveräne Moderation & Beratung: Erfahrung in Konzeption und Durchführung von Strategie-Workshops sowie in der zielgerichteten Moderation von Kundenterminen.

  • Ausgeprägtes Business- & Finanzverständnis: Kennzahlen wie NRR, Margen, Pipeline-Ökonomie und Kundenrentabilität sind für dich vertrautes Handwerkszeug. 

  • Analytisches Gespür & Proaktivität: Du erkennst aus scheinbar kleinen Signalen – etwa veränderten Budgetfreigaben, neuen Ansprechpartnern oder verzögerten Rückmeldungen – frühzeitig Chancen oder Risiken und leitest konkrete nächste Schritte daraus ab. 

  • Führung durch Überzeugung: Du überzeugst interdisziplinäre Teams inhaltlich für gemeinsame Ziele, auch ohne disziplinarische Weisungsbefugnis.


Deine Benefits:

  • Team & Atmosphäre: Familiäres, teamorientiertes Umfeld mit motivierten Kolleg:innen – hier entstehen Freundschaften.

  • Gute Kommunikation: Offene Feedbackkultur und kurze, unbürokratische Wege.

  • Spannende Aufgaben: Abwechslungsreiche Projekte mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum.

  • Flexibilität: Home Office und flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance. 

  • Transparente Zeitregelung: Jede Überstunde zählt – ab der ersten Minute.

  • Teamevents: Von Dönerstag bis Kinderfasching - wir lieben unsere regelmäßigen gemeinsamen Aktivitäten. 

  • Gesundheit & Umwelt: JobRad-Angebot für nachhaltige Mobilität.


Das sind wir:

In Zahlen: 1 Headquarter, über 100 Köpfe, 16 Nationalitäten 

schoene neue kinder ist eine wachsende Digitalagentur mit dem Fokus auf Digital Customer Experiences. Unsere DNA besteht zu 100 % aus Design und zu 100 % aus Technologie.

Unsere Unternehmenskultur wird von klar definierten Werten getragen, die unser tägliches Miteinander und unsere Arbeit prägen: Qualität steht für uns an erster Stelle – in unseren Projekten, unserer Zusammenarbeit und unseren Lösungen. Wir übernehmen Verantwortung für unser Handeln und treiben unsere Projekte mit Pragmatismus voran, um effizient und wirkungsvoll Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Klare und offene Kommunikation ist die Grundlage unseres Erfolgs – sie fördert nicht nur großartige Ideen, sondern auch eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit.

Wir glauben an echten Team Spirit – wir unterstützen uns gegenseitig, feiern Erfolge gemeinsam und wachsen miteinander.  Und nicht zuletzt: Dankbarkeit ist für uns essentiell – für unser Team, das mit Leidenschaft und Kreativität Großes schafft, für unsere Kunden, die uns ihr Vertrauen schenken, und für die Möglichkeit, gemeinsam digitale Erlebnisse zu gestalten.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative - EMEA
jobs.description:
About AirOps

AirOps is the full-service platform for brand growth in the age of AI search. As consumers shift from traditional search engines to platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, the entire ruleset of growth is being rewritten. Buyers now rely on agents to discover, recommend, and purchase products and services for them. If your brand isn't part of the answer, you aren't in the running.

Our platform offers everything a brand needs to get found, recommended, and earn trust. We work with category leaders, including teams at Ramp, Chime, Airbnb, ServiceNow, and Rippling, to drive visibility and accelerate growth from AI search.

Backed by Greylock, Unusual Ventures, Wing VC, and Founder Collective, we're headquartered in San Francisco, New York, and Montevideo.

About the Role:

AirOps is opening its first dedicated EMEA sales development role at a moment when AI-driven content discovery is reshaping how European brands compete. You will own the full outbound motion across EMEA, prospecting into marketing and growth teams in the UK, DACH, Nordics, Benelux, France, Southern Europe, and beyond. This is not a UK-only seat.

You will build pipeline across multiple markets, navigating different buying cultures and business contexts every day. You'll work cross-functionally with Sales and GTM Engineering to turn intent signals into qualified discovery calls that map prospect pain to our AI capabilities. Based hybrid out of our central London office, you are the first face of AirOps for EMEA buyers. The role reports into our Sales leadership and carries a direct line to how quickly we scale internationally. If you want a front-row seat to building a region from scratch, this is it.

 

What you'll own:

  • Build the Engine: As one of the founding EMEA SDRs, you'll develop and execute creative outreach strategies that don't just hit targets, they crush them. You'll be the one finding the "needles in the haystack" and turning them into qualified pipeline.

  • Be an AI Matchmaker: Conduct discovery calls that act as deep-dive consultations. Your goal is to map prospect pain points to our AI capabilities, not just read a script.

  • Own the First Impression: You are the first face of AirOps. You’ll build authentic, high-trust relationships with key decision-makers before they even realize they need a better workflow.

  • Pass the Torch: Work in lockstep with our Account Executives to ensure that every handoff is seamless, qualified, and set up for a closed-won win.

  • The "Data Artist": Keep our CRM (our "Source of Truth") clean, organized, and actionable. We value data-driven iteration—if an email template isn't working, iterate, A/B test, and optimize until it does.

  • Startup Speed: In a high-growth environment, agility is your superpower. Whether you're troubleshooting a new outreach tool or jumping on a last-minute demo, you thrive on the "all-hands-on-deck" pace.

 

What you'll bring:

  • The "Hungry" Factor: 0-1 years of B2B SaaS sales experience. If you’ve got the grit, we’ll provide the roadmap. Bonus points if you’ve spent time in the marketing or growth-tech trenches.

  • Outreach Ninja: Whether it's a cold call, a hyper-personalized email, or a strategic LinkedIn connection, you know how to cut through the noise without sounding like a bot.

  • High EQ & Active Listening: You know that discovery is 80% listening and 20% speaking. You have the empathy to understand a prospect's frustrations and the communication skills to offer the solution.

  • Bias for Action: You are just as comfortable running solo on a new project as you are jumping into a team brainstorming session. You own your outcomes.

  • A Track Record of "Done": Whether it’s a side project, a degree, or a previous job, you have a history of starting things and actually finishing them.

  • The Vibe-Coder Mindset: We build with AI, and we want you to understand it. Experience coding, scripting, or playing around with "vibe-coding" platforms (Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, etc.) is a massive plus. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you've ideally gone beyond simply using LLMs as research and content-generation tools.

  • Nice to have: Fluent in a European language beyond English. German, French, Spanish, Dutch, or a Nordic language would open doors across key EMEA markets.

Compensation Band: £65-80K OTE [60/40]

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, Badoo
jobs.description:
Introduction to Role & Team

The Role

The team is seven people across the US and UK. You will set direction, connect marketing to the commercial number, and run as one go-to-market unit with our (Re)Insurance Sales and Broker Sales leaders.

 

Based in London or New York, with regular travel across the US and Europe.

 

What You Will Do

  • Own and lead the full marketing function: demand generation, product marketing, and communications/events, including the team across the US and UK and the complete marketing budget.

  • International experience. Has run marketing across US and European markets and managed a team split across time zones.

  • Budget ownership. Has held and defended a full marketing budget, made real allocation trade-offs between headcount, programmes, brand and events, and can evidence return.

  • Executive credible. Articulate on the commercial argument, unfazed by seniority, trusted to carry the CyberCube story.

  • A high accountability people leader who raises the bar on an existing team. Sets clear expectations, gives direct feedback, and is respected for it.

  • Strong editorial judgment and taste. Will not ship undifferentiated content, and can tell the difference between a message that resonates with the market and one that only resonates internally.

  • Partners with Sales and Product by choice, not by process. Low ego, high candour. Comfortable disagreeing with the executive team and being disagreed with.

  • Based in London, with regular international travel across the US and Europe.

 

Strong Plus

  • Has scaled a marketing function through a step change in growth expectations.

  • Comfort in a fast-moving, AI-enabled commercial function. AI-assisted content production, agentic prospecting, automated reporting, no traditional SDR layer.

AI is reshaping how work gets done across every function. We value people who are curious about AI, eager to learn, and thoughtful about applying AI tools to work more effectively. AI fluency is part of how we assess every role in our hiring process.

jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

This is a people-leadership role from day one. You will manage the team — hiring, coaching, performance, growth paths, honest feedback — while staying close to the code: roughly half your time in architecture decisions and the hardest technical problems the team faces, the other half leading your squad. If you are looking for a senior IC role, this is not it.

AI agents don't run in browsers. They run in sandboxes — and you will lead the team building ours.

We build secure, isolated, network-controlled environments with snapshotting primitives, designed for AI agents and reinforcement-learning workloads. An RL training run doesn't need one environment; it needs thousands, created and destroyed every second. An agent needs to be sandboxed from the world while still feeling fast enough to be useful. That tension — airtight isolation, at fleet scale, at low latency — is the product.

Your customers are the people building the next generation of AI software on our infrastructure; the primitives you ship become the runtime their agents live in.

What You Will Do

  • Build the isolation layer: microVMs or containers, namespaces, cgroups, seccomp, snapshot and restore.

  • Own the security boundary. Customers run code they didn't write and can't fully trust — your systems make that safe.

  • Scale to fleets: creation latency, density, and lifecycle management for thousands of concurrent environments.

  • Write Go alongside your team and own the architecture and the hardest implementation decisions.

  • Grow the engineers, not just the software — set the standard for ownership and coach people past their comfort zone.

  • Own people management for the team: hiring, performance, growth paths, and honest feedback.

  • Partner with Product Managers to turn frontier research needs into shippable primitives.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of real people leadership. You have managed engineers — hired, coached, given honest feedback, and grown them. Hands-on contribution matters here, but this role is judged on the team you build and lead, not just the code you write.

  • Deep Linux internals: namespaces, cgroups, seccomp, virtualization — ideally microVMs of the Firecracker class.

  • You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

  • You understand network isolation at the packet level — not just firewall rules.

  • Performance instincts: you know what a syscall costs, and you have the profiles to prove you've cared.

  • 8+ years building backend or infrastructure systems.

  • You have partnered with product, design, and business teams to ship software that reached real users.

  • A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

A datacenter is not a cloud until software makes it one. You will lead the team that turns arriving hardware into accepted clusters.

Cabling validation, burn-in, firmware, deployment validation, software stack install — all of it automated, none of it click-ops. This is a founding leadership role at the intersection of hardware and software. Early on it is deliberately hands-on: most of your time in the code and the architecture, some of it on datacenter floors, because the automation has to survive contact with the machines it runs on.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez Pennylane ?

L’ANECS et le CJEC réunissent une génération qui contribue déjà à façonner le cabinet de demain : collaborateurs en cabinet, stagiaires experts-comptables, mémorialistes, jeunes diplômés, créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes experts-comptables installés.
Tous ne créeront pas leur cabinet. Beaucoup évolueront au sein de structures existantes et participeront directement à leur transformation : nouvelles pratiques de production, développement de nouvelles missions, adoption de l’IA, structuration commerciale, attractivité des équipes et amélioration de la productivité.
Pour les membres en phase d’installation, de reprise ou déjà installés, les enjeux sont très concrets : choisir les bons outils, développer leur activité, structurer les équipes et les missions, gagner en efficacité et identifier de nouveaux leviers de croissance. Pennylane a un rôle à jouer au-delà de celui d’un simple éditeur : devenir un partenaire de développement business et de productivité pour les cabinets qui se créent, se transforment et grandissent.

L’ANECS et le CJEC constituent un écosystème national et régional dense, avec près de 50 sections. Les bureaux se renouvellent en alternance, une année sur deux, ce qui demande une animation relationnelle continue et une transmission structurée entre les équipes sortantes et entrantes.

Ce poste est clé pour :

  • construire une préférence durable pour Pennylane auprès de la nouvelle génération de la profession comptable ;

  • accompagner les membres dans leurs enjeux de carrière, de développement de cabinet et de transformation des pratiques ;

  • transformer les partenariats, événements et prises de parole en contacts qualifiés, signaux d’intention et opportunités ;

  • sécuriser une relation continue avec les instances nationales et les sections régionales ;

  • faire de Pennylane un partenaire reconnu pour développer le business et la productivité des cabinets.


Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

  • Tu construis et animes la relation entre Pennylane et l’écosystème ANECS-CJEC. Ta mission est de faire de Pennylane un partenaire de référence pour celles et ceux qui font évoluer la profession comptable : futurs experts-comptables, collaborateurs en cabinet, créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes installés.

  • Tu combines une forte présence terrain, l’animation d’une communauté active, la construction de contenus utiles et un travail étroit avec l’équipe commerciale. Tu développes une connaissance fine des membres, de leurs parcours et de leurs besoins afin d’identifier les moments pertinents pour activer Pennylane : évolution professionnelle, projet d’installation, reprise, recrutement, développement de nouvelles missions ou besoin de gagner en productivité.

  • Tu pilotes la relation nationale avec l’ANECS et le CJEC, animes le réseau des sections régionales et assures la continuité de la relation lors du renouvellement alterné des bureaux.

  • Tu conçois et portes les activations les plus pertinentes : événements, ateliers, contenus, formats communautaires et prises de parole.

  • En lien étroit avec l’équipe commerciale, tu contribues aux initiatives auprès des créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes cabinets. Tu développes une communauté qualifiée, identifies les signaux d’intention et assures la bonne transmission des opportunités aux équipes commerciales, au bon moment dans le parcours de chaque contact.

  • Tu seras rattaché·e à Cyril Chanson, Manager Partenariats – Profession Comptable, et travailleras au quotidien avec les équipes Sales, Marketing, Enablement, Éducation et Événementiel.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?
Pilotage du partenariat national — 20 %

  • Porter la relation nationale avec l’ANECS et le CJEC de bout en bout : convention annuelle, gouvernance, budget, négociation des contreparties et plan d’activation.

  • Gérer le budget sponsoring et événementiel, estimé à environ35 k€ par an, et en suivre le retour sur investissement.

  • Sécuriser puis activer les contreparties les plus utiles : visibilité, contenus, prises de parole, accès aux sections, formats exclusifs et opportunités de qualification.

  • Construire une relation de confiance avec les instances nationales et assurer la continuité du partenariat dans la durée.


Animation du réseau et présence terrain — 30 %

  • Animer la communauté ANECS-CJEC au niveau national et régional, avec une présence régulière auprès des sections, de leurs bureaux et de leurs membres.

  • Maintenir un mapping fiable des élus, ambassadeurs et relais locaux ; préparer activement les passations entre bureaux sortants et entrants.

  • Construire et exécuter un plan de présence terrain ambitieux et priorisé : congrès, Estivales, DEC After, soirées jeunes inscrits, Olympiades, Journées des Jeunes Inscrits, tables rondes et événements locaux.

  • Concevoir des activations utiles et engageantes : ateliers, témoignages, formats de networking, démonstrations, échanges entre pairs et prises de parole.

  • Assurer le suivi post-événement : qualification des contacts, activation de la communauté, transmission des signaux pertinents aux équipes commerciales et partage des apprentissages terrain.

  • Travailler avec la responsable événementielle sur la préparation et l’organisation des événements prioritaires.

Initiatives auprès des créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes cabinets — 20 %

  • Co-construire avec l’équipe commerciale les initiatives destinées aux créateurs, repreneurs et jeunes cabinets : ciblage, calendrier, offres, contenus, événements et parcours d’activation.

  • Apporter une connaissance fine des parcours, besoins et signaux d’intention observés au sein de la communauté ANECS-CJEC.

  • Identifier les moments où Pennylane peut créer de la valeur : installation, reprise, structuration d’équipe, choix des outils, développement de nouvelles missions, vente, IA ou productivité.

  • Qualifier et transmettre les contacts et projets à fort potentiel à l’équipe commerciale selon un processus partagé.

  • Suivre, avec l’équipe commerciale, la contribution de ces initiatives au pipeline et au MRR attribuables au canal.


Stratégie d’activation, contenus et communauté — 20 %

  • Définir et animer une stratégie de communauté combinant présence physique, rendez-vous digitaux, contenus, email, social media et relais locaux.

  • Concevoir des formats utiles aux membres à chaque étape de leur parcours : réussite du diplôme, découverte des formes d’exercice, installation, reprise, développement ou modernisation d’un cabinet.

  • Développer des contenus et événements autour des enjeux qui transforment les cabinets : IA, productivité, nouvelles missions, organisation, recrutement, développement commercial et expérience client.

  • Formaliser les besoins, briefer l’équipe Enablement et coordonner la production des contenus.

  • Construire, segmenter et animer dans la durée une base de communauté qualifiée, dans le respect des règles de consentement et de gestion des données.


Pilotage de la performance et veille — 10 %

  • Suivre la couverture du réseau, les contacts générés, la qualité des leads, l’engagement de la communauté, les signaux détectés, le pipeline influencé, le MRR attribuable, le budget et le ROI.

  • Produire un reporting trimestriel présentant les résultats, les apprentissages terrain et les arbitrages de priorisation recommandés.

  • Assurer une veille sur les initiatives des concurrents auprès des jeunes professionnels de la profession comptable et proposer les réponses adaptées.

  • Identifier les territoires, sections et formats les plus performants afin de concentrer les moyens sur les actions à plus fort potentiel.


Profil recherché :
Tu disposes d’environ 4 à 6 ans d’expérience dans les partenariats B2B, l’animation de réseau, le community growth, le développement commercial indirect ou le marketing terrain à forte dimension business.
Tu as déjà évolué dans un environnement où il faut articuler une stratégie nationale avec des relais locaux : partenaires, antennes, ambassadeurs, clients et équipes internes. Tu sais transformer une présence terrain ou une communauté en dynamique mesurable de contacts, d’engagement et d’opportunités.
Tu apprécies particulièrement le terrain, les déplacements réguliers en région et les échanges directs avec des communautés professionnelles. Tu es autant à l’aise dans une relation avec un président de section que dans l’animation d’un atelier devant des membres, ou dans le suivi rigoureux d’une base de contacts et de ses signaux business.

Compétences indispensables :

  • Animation de réseau et de communauté: créer des relations durables avec des interlocuteurs variés, identifier les bons relais, animer une communauté et maintenir la continuité malgré les changements de personnes.

  • Appétence terrain: aimer aller au contact des professionnels dans les régions, participer à des événements et transformer une présence ponctuelle en relation durable.

  • Partenariats stratégiques: piloter une convention nationale, négocier des contreparties, gérer un budget et faire vivre un partenariat au-delà de sa signature.

  • Orientation business: identifier les actions, sections et événements les plus porteurs ; comprendre les besoins des membres et faire remonter les bons signaux à l’équipe commerciale.

  • Community growth: structurer une base de contacts, la segmenter, créer des séquences d’animation et développer l’engagement dans la durée.

  • Prise de parole et pédagogie: animer un atelier ou un webinaire, et rendre accessibles des sujets liés à la vente, l’IA, la productivité, les missions ou le développement du cabinet.

  • Pilotage par la donnée: suivre l’engagement, les signaux, la couverture territoriale, le pipeline, le MRR attribuable et le ROI des activations.

  • Coordination transverse: travailler efficacement avec les équipes Sales, Marketing, Enablement, Éducation et Événementiel.

  • Autonomie: prendre en main un périmètre national, proposer un plan, l’exécuter et faire remonter les arbitrages nécessaires au bon moment.


Ce qui serait un plus, sans être obligatoire

  • Une connaissance de la profession comptable, du parcours vers le DEC ou de l’installation en cabinet.

  • Un réseau auprès de l’ANECS, du CJEC, des écoles de comptabilité-gestion, des incubateurs ou des réseaux de jeunes entrepreneurs.

  • Une expérience dans un environnement SaaS, fintech, outils de gestion ou accompagnement d’entrepreneurs.

  • La maîtrise de Salesforce, HubSpot, Brevo ou d’un outil comparable.

  • Une expérience de création de contenu B2B ou d’animation de réseaux sociaux professionnels.



Processus de recrutement :

  1. Échange de 30 minutes en visio avec un·e Business Recruiter.

  2. Entretien de 45 minutes avec Cyril Chanson, Manager Partenariats – Profession Comptable.

  3. Étude de cas d’une heure avec Cyril et Valentin Notteau, Head of Sales Accounting Firms, ou Claudia, Sales Team Lead — idéalement en présentiel.

  4. Entretien final de 45 minutes avec Édouard, Head of Sales.

  5. Team fit avec les principales équipes partenaires, en visio ou présentiel.

jobs.title: (Senior) Design System Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
ZEAL Network SE is a dynamic, international group of companies that has been creating exciting and innovative lottery experiences for over 20 years. As Germany’s largest provider of online lotteries through our brands LOTTO24 and Tipp24, and a trusted partner of Spain’s ONCE, the second-largest national lottery, we’re shaping the future of the lottery industry. We are passionate about driving innovation, as demonstrated by our newest brands, Freiheit+ and Traumhausverlosung, which bring fresh and exciting dreams to life. Additionally, through ZEAL Ventures, we invest in inspiring e-commerce start-ups like Omaze and DAYMADE, fueling fresh ideas and opportunities.

Our team of 350+ professionals from diverse backgrounds is united by a visionary mindset, a passion for collaboration, and a commitment to inspire dreams. At ZEAL, we empower our people to think ambitiously and work together toward a shared purpose: helping people imagine and achieve their aspirations.

 

Your tasks:

  • Evolve, expand and maintain our component libraries on all our platforms (iOS, Android and Web): Angular, Jetpack Compose, SwiftUI fed by a shared design system.

  • Partner closely with our UI/UX designers on component APIs, naming, states, and variants, keeping our code in sync with our Figma library - closing the gap between what is designed and what ships.

  • Define the system's architecture: theming and brand layering, versioning, releases, and a contribution model that invites our domain teams in rather than shutting them out.

  • Maintain living documentation (e.g. Storybook) and drive adoption through pairing, reviews, and migration paths.

  • Make accessibility and responsive behavior built-in properties of our components, not an afterthought.

  • Adopt agentic coding practices and use AI coding agents to accelerate development, while maintaining ownership of technical decisions, code quality, and outcomes.

What you offer us:

  • Several years as a frontend or mobile engineer, including hands-on ownership of a design system or shared component library used by multiple teams.

  • TypeScript and Angular skills or comparable depth in another modern framework / library and a clear willingness to go all in on Angular plus a sharp instinct for component API design.

  • Hands-on native UI development with Kotlin/Jetpack Compose or Swift/SwiftUI. You will author native components yourself. Strong expertise in one platform, combined with an interest in developing a working knowledge of the other, is perfectly fine.

  • Experience with design tokens and theming multi-brand environments: building one system that carries several brands without forking.

  • A strong grasp of responsive and adaptive design and of accessibility standards, and the habit of verifying both in practice.

  • A product mindset toward internal tooling, you treat the design system and component libraries as a product with users and measure success by adoption. You enjoy enabling other teams and building consensus across engineering and design.

What we offer:

  • State-of-the-art technologies and an agile environment (Check our Tech Radar: https://lotto24.github.io/tech-radar/)

  • A modern, dynamic culture grounded in the success of a leading-edge e-commerce company.

  • A talented team of ambitious, like-minded colleagues where your knowledge and ideas truly make an impact.

  • Ongoing personal growth, supported by an annual development budget of €1,500 to invest in your professional development.

  • Trust and autonomy, no micromanagement, just confidence in your ability to deliver and excel.

  • Flexible work options with a hybrid setup focused on results.

  • Unlimited vacation days in addition to your yearly 30-day vacation allowance.

  • Opportunity for workations abroad using our WorkFlex tool.

  • Monthly mobility allowance of €30 to use on the mobility option of your choice (e.g., the Deutschlandticket), plus access to a company bike leasing program.

  • Company pension scheme, provided in partnership with Degura, to support your future financial security.

  • Subsidized EGYM WELLPASS membership, with a contribution of only €25 per month, giving you access to a wide range of gyms and sports options across Germany.

  • Quarterly company events, along with regular team activities and informal gatherings, a favorite being our Healthy Tuesday lunches or Treat Thursdays in the office!

 

Sounds exciting? Great! We're looking forward to receiving your online application.

jobs.title: Strategy Manager Krankentransport (m/w/d) – Business Development & Go-to-Market
jobs.description:
Deine Aufgaben

Als Strategy Manager Krankentransport (m/w/d) verantwortest du Business Development, Go-to-Market und die Vermarktung unserer Software für Krankentransportdienstleister. Du ergänzt unser Produktteam – zwei erfahrene Product Owner mit tiefer technischer und marktseitiger Expertise – um die Themen Business Development, Go-to-Market und Marketing und übernimmst eigenständig die Schnittstelle zwischen Produkt und Sales.
 
Dein Ziel: Unsere Software für Krankentransporteure erfolgreich im Markt zu positionieren und eigenständig neue Geschäftspotenziale zu erschließen – von der Business-Case-Entwicklung über Kooperationsverhandlungen bis zur erfolgreichen Markteinführung.

  • Go-to-Market: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unserem Produktteam die Go-to-Market-Strategie für neue Produktthemen und verantwortest deren erfolgreiche Markteinführung.
  • Business Development: Du identifizierst neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und Verticals, bewertest sie anhand von Zahlen und entwickelst daraus belastbare Business Cases.
  • Partnerschaften & Kooperationen: Du führst eigenständig Kooperationsverhandlungen mit Partnern aus (Groß-)Unternehmen und baust strategische Partnerschaften auf.
  • Schnittstelle Produkt & Sales: Du agierst als Bindeglied zwischen unserem Produktteam und Sales und übersetzt Produktthemen in überzeugende Vermarktungs- und Vertriebsargumente.
  • Business Case & Priorisierung: Du bewertest Geschäftschancen anhand von Zahlen und priorisierst sie nach Kundennutzen, Geschäftspotenzial und Aufwand.
  • Projektsteuerung: Du treibst deine Projekte eigenständig und dynamisch voran – von der ersten Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung im Markt.


Dein Profil

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Marketing oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Mindestens 2-3 Jahre Erfahrung in einer relevanten Rolle, z. B. in der Beratung, im Business Development (Großunternehmen, Mittelstand oder Scale-up/Start-up) oder im Marketing mit klarem Go-to-Market-Bezug
  • Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Führung von Kooperations- oder Vertragsverhandlungen mit B2B-Partnern aus (Groß-)Unternehmen.
  • Ausgeprägte Eigenständigkeit und die Fähigkeit, Projekte dynamisch zwischen Produktteam und Sales zu steuern
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Zahlen und ein klarer Blick für belastbare Business Cases; Kenntnisse im deutschen Gesundheitswesen sind ein Plus, aber kein Muss
  • Ausgeprägtes Stakeholder-Gesprächsgeschick, Entscheidungsfreude und unternehmerisches Denken
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.


Deine Benefits

  • Einstieg in ein zukunftsorientiertes Unternehmen im spannenden Healthcare-SaaS Umfeld
  • Sinnstiftende Mission: Digitalisierung, die Krankentransporteure wirklich entlastet
  • Eine individuelle, strukturierte Einarbeitung mit regelmäßigem Feedback sowie Förderung durch unser Mentorenprogramm
  • Die Möglichkeit, selbstständig und verantwortungsvoll zu arbeiten und eigene Ideen einzubringen
  • Individuelle und vielfältige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • 30 Urlaubstage pro Jahr, flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung und bis zu 2 Tage mobiles Arbeiten pro Woche (Montag & Freitag)
  • Gemeinsames Mittagessen mittwochs und donnerstags – frisch zubereitet von unserem Küchenchef Ingo
  • Gemeinsam Erfolge feiern bei Teamevents

jobs.title: Product Builder
jobs.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

At Camunda, we are evolving how software gets built. We are looking for a Product Builder to help shape the enterprise and governance experience of Camunda Hub by combining product thinking, user empathy, UX judgment, and hands-on execution. This is a high-ownership role inside our Products organization for someone who wants to move quickly, work directly with customers and forward deployed engineers, and build in an AI-first environment.

Camunda Hub is the unified management platform through which teams govern their processes, manage access, and administer the platform at enterprise scale. You will join the Enterprise & Governance pod, which owns the surfaces enterprise Centres of Excellence and platform administrators rely on: access control and permissions, workspace and tenant management, audit and compliance features, and the administration and configuration UI for clusters and platform settings.

The role will contribute across the full stack, enabling faster end-to-end product delivery.

What you'll be doing:

  •  Discover and clarify meaningful user problems for administrators, CoE teams, and enterprise architects by working closely with customers, forward deployed engineers, and internal stakeholders

  • Shape product direction through practical judgment, fast iteration, and a strong focus on solving the underlying problem rather than only implementing requests

  • Prototype, build, harden, ship, and iterate on product improvements across the enterprise and governance surfaces of Hub - access control, workspace and tenant management, audit and compliance, and platform administration

  • Use AI tools effectively to accelerate first drafts, implementation steps, iteration, and learning while maintaining a strong quality bar

  • Work closely with other builders and product strategy counterparts to turn ideas into shipped outcomes, including across boundaries with Core / Identity where governance surfaces build on platform contracts

  • Improve the speed, quality, and effectiveness of how the pod delivers product end-to-end

What you bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

  • Experience shipping product directly in a software environment

  • Ability to work fluidly across product thinking, user experience, and hands-on delivery

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and turning open-ended problems into practical next steps

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills in a remote-first, pod-based environment

  • Curiosity about users, fast learning loops, and a bias toward improving the product through iteration

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping product in a software context, not only coordinating roadmap or requirements

  • Strong AI-native delivery habits: able to use AI tools effectively for first drafts, implementation steps, and iteration, while reviewing and improving weak output rather than accepting it

  • Ability to describe and shape intended user experience clearly, including flow, hierarchy, states, copy, and accessibility expectations

  • Strong product and customer judgment: able to understand the user problem behind a request, use lightweight evidence and customer feedback, and make pragmatic decisions that create broader product value

  • Sound technical judgment within an established architecture, including the ability to test what was built, trace issues, understand frontend/backend boundaries, and contribute beyond a pure frontend scope over time

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with workflow software, orchestration, admin/platform tooling, or similarly technical product surfaces

  • Experience working in small, high-autonomy pods with broad ownership across discovery, design, and delivery

  • Familiarity with enterprise governance concerns: identity and access management, RBAC and permission models, multi-tenancy, audit logging, or compliance-driven requirements

  • Experience designing for administrator and platform-operator personas

  • Ability to capture validation learnings clearly, distinguish signal from noise, and help improve lightweight product validation practices

This role is an existing vacancy

#LI-AG1 #LI-Remote #USEAST #C1

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

United States: $119,900.00 to $193,200.00

United Kingdom: £75,300.00 to £123,800.00

Singapore: S$148,900.00 to S$223,300.00

Canada: to C$127,300.00 to C$209,300.00

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here
